SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation school'
  AND frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, c.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, SUM(c.TotalConsumption) / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM czk_2013 c
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND c.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

SELECT

    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    MAX(
        l.amount - l.payments * (
            (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_DATE) AS INT) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INT)) * 12
            + (CAST(STRFTIME('%m', CURRENT_DATE) AS INT) - CAST(STRFTIME('%m', l.date) AS INT))

    ) AS remaining_debt

JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT p.Segment,
           SUM(p.total_cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON m.Segment = p.Segment AND p.total_cons = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM seg_avg;

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cc.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment m ON cc.Segment = m.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000

SELECT DISTINCT
       d.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
       - (SELECT MIN(di2.A11)
          FROM client c2
          JOIN district di2 ON di2.district_id = c2.district_id
          WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
            AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')) AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(di3.A11)
                FROM client c3
                JOIN district di3 ON di3.district_id = c3.district_id
                WHERE c3.gender = 'F'
                  AND c3.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'))

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
mincons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segavg AS (
    SELECT a.Segment, SUM(a.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM annual a
    JOIN mincons m ON m.Segment = a.Segment AND a.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY a.Segment

  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
     FROM yearmonth AS T1

    WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM'

     FROM yearmonth AS T1

    WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM'

                              JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                             WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM'
                               AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'

  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)

WITH czk_annual AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT ca.Segment, SUM(ca.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_annual ca
    JOIN min_consumption mc
      ON ca.Segment = mc.Segment
     AND ca.total_consumption = mc.min_total
    GROUP BY ca.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
least_consumers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM cust_totals t
    JOIN min_totals m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS avg_consumption
    FROM least_consumers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND (M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal) < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        AND overall_rating > (
            SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
            FROM Player_Attributes
            WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        )
  );

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_fifa_api_id = TA.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND TA.buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT T2.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.date) = '2012'
  AND T1.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(T3.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T4.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS T3
      JOIN Team AS T4 ON T3.team_api_id = T4.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', T3.date) = '2012'
        AND T3.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(T1.long_shots) / COUNT(T1.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player AS T2
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T1 ON T2.player_api_id = T1.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_fifa_api_id = PA.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) * 1.0 / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T2.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND T1.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND T1.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND T1.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY T1.chanceCreationPassing DESC;
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers'

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';
SELECT T1.heading_accuracy FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Francois Affolter' AND T1.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND Match.season = '2015/2016'
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY birthday DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands'

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Poland'
  AND m.season = '2010/2011';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1990';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', PA.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT Team_Attributes.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team
JOIN Team_Attributes ON Team.team_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70
SELECT T2.name FROM League AS T1 JOIN Country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T1.name = 'Italy Serie A'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match 
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id 
WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' 
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', Match.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
ORDER BY PA.crossing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_count
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(Match.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT l.name
FROM League l
JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < '1986'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.preferred_foot
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'
SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'

SELECT T2.player_name
FROM Player AS T2
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T1 ON T2.player_api_id = T1.player_api_id
WHERE T1.overall_rating = 77
  AND T1.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY T2.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT PA.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND PA.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';
SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud' AND T2.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND substr(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id IN (T2.home_player_1, T2.home_player_2, T2.home_player_3, T2.home_player_4, T2.home_player_5, T2.home_player_6, T2.home_player_7, T2.home_player_8, T2.home_player_9, T2.home_player_10, T2.home_player_11, T2.away_player_1, T2.away_player_2, T2.away_player_3, T2.away_player_4, T2.away_player_5, T2.away_player_6, T2.away_player_7, T2.away_player_8, T2.away_player_9, T2.away_player_10, T2.away_player_11)
JOIN Country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

WITH CountryAvgWeight AS (
    SELECT
        M.country_id AS country_id,
        AVG(P.weight) AS avg_weight
    FROM Match AS M
    JOIN Player AS P
      ON P.player_api_id IN (
           M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
           M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
           M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
           M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
         )
    GROUP BY M.country_id
)
SELECT C.name
FROM Country AS C
JOIN CountryAvgWeight AS CAW ON CAW.country_id = C.id
WHERE CAW.avg_weight = (SELECT MAX(avg_weight) FROM CountryAvgWeight);

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow'

    SELECT * FROM Match
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
)

    SELECT home_player_7 FROM m UNION

SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account
WHERE account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan)
  AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'Prague');
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district
JOIN client ON district.district_id = client.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND district.A11 > 6000 AND district.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT DISTINCT
       a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) -
       (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
       ) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d3.A11)
               FROM client c3
               JOIN district d3 ON c3.district_id = d3.district_id
               WHERE c3.gender = 'F'
                 AND c3.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
              )

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND T2.status = 'C'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
INNER JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE account.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND trans.balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a 
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1996'

SELECT T1.account_id, T1.frequency
FROM account AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T2.type = 'OWNER'
  AND T4.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY A16 DESC LIMIT 1);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '95-01-01' AND '97-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN "order" o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek' AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO';

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM disp d
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3 AS region
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '97' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) IN ('96', '97');

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference_1996;

SELECT strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.account_id = 130
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT loan.amount AS debt_amount,
       loan.payments AS monthly_payment,
       loan.duration AS duration_months,
       loan.status AS payment_status
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN loan ON disp.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE client.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(T1.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
WHERE T3.client_id = 617
  AND T1.type = 'withdrawal'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1998';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1996;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.duration = 24 
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT c.client_id,
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM attendance 
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id 
WHERE event.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(link_to_event) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE a.attendance_count = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(link_to_event) AS cnt
        FROM attendance
        GROUP BY link_to_event
    ) t
);

SELECT COUNT(event.event_id) AS num_events
FROM event
JOIN attendance ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
JOIN member ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND member.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND YEAR(event.event_date) = 2019

SELECT COUNT(event_id)
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND event_id IN (
      SELECT link_to_event
      FROM attendance
      GROUP BY link_to_event
      HAVING COUNT(link_to_event) > 10
  );

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(a.event_id) > 20

SELECT CAST(COUNT(e.event_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting' AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name
FROM member
JOIN attendance ON member.member_id = attendance.link_to_member
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT SUM(T1.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget AS T1
JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id
WHERE T1.category = 'Food' AND T2.event_name = 'September Meeting';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';
SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'
SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM budget 
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id 
WHERE event.event_name = 'November Meeting' 
  AND budget.remaining < 0;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.source = 'Dues'
  AND T2.date_received = (SELECT MIN(date_received) FROM income WHERE source = 'Dues')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.category = 'Parking' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(e.event_name) AS percentage
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'November Speaker';
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy' AND m.last_name = 'Firth';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS maryland_members
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.state = 'Maryland';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE type = 'Meeting' AND YEAR(event_date) = 2020

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense ex ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT SUM(major_name = 'Finance') / SUM(major_name = 'Physics') AS ratio
FROM major
JOIN member ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id

SELECT t_shirt_size
FROM member
GROUP BY t_shirt_size
HAVING COUNT(t_shirt_size) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(t_shirt_size) AS cnt
        FROM member
        GROUP BY t_shirt_size
    ) AS counts
)

SELECT T1.event_name
FROM event AS T1

   FROM customers AS T1

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    INNER JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_totals t
    INNER JOIN min_totals m
        ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS running_contracts
FROM loan l
INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND d.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS male_clients
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
INNER JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
INNER JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
INNER JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
INNER JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
INNER JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
INNER JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha' AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT c.type
FROM card c
INNER JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE d.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_women
FROM client c
INNER JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
INNER JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
       * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    INNER JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
) m ON l.account_id = m.account_id
WHERE SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client c
INNER JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND d.disp_id = 130;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
INNER JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT l.loan_id,
       l.amount AS loan_amount,
       l.status,
       CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B', 'D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END AS debt_amount,
       CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B', 'D') THEN 'IN DEBT' ELSE 'PAYING OK' END AS payment_status,
       l.payments,
       l.duration,
       l.date
FROM client c
INNER JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
INNER JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM client c
INNER JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
INNER JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account INNER JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun' AND account.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan
INNER JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.duration = 24
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT cl.client_id, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client cl
INNER JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
INNER JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT 
    CASE WHEN a.cnt > b.cnt THEN 'in-patient' ELSE 'outpatient' END AS more_common,
    a.cnt AS inpatient_count,
    b.cnt AS outpatient_count,
    ROUND(a.cnt * 100.0 / b.cnt, 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT COUNT(ID) AS cnt FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+') a
    INNER JOIN 
    (SELECT COUNT(ID) AS cnt FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-') b;
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT Patient.ID, SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Date, YEAR(T2.`First Date`) - YEAR(T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS Average_Age
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT `aCL IgM`
FROM Examination

WITH cust_total AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_total AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_total
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, ct.total_consumption
    FROM cust_total ct
    JOIN min_total mt
      ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_consumption
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM lowest;

    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm."CDSCode" = schools."CDSCode"
    WHERE schools."SOCType" = 'Continuation High School'
),
q2 AS (
    SELECT q1."CDSCode",
           q1."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / NULLIF(q1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) AS eligible_free_rate
    FROM q1
)
SELECT eligible_free_rate
FROM q2
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

),
q2 AS (

FROM schools AS T1

)

WITH q1 AS (

FROM customers
WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
q2 AS (
SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
q3 AS (
SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
FROM q2
GROUP BY Segment
),
q4 AS (
SELECT t.Segment, t.CustomerID, t.TotalConsumption
FROM (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
) t
JOIN (
    SELECT d.Segment, MIN(d.TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM (
        SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
        FROM yearmonth y
        JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
    ) d
    GROUP BY d.Segment
) m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND m.MinConsumption = t.TotalConsumption
),
q5 AS (
SELECT t.Segment,
       SUM(t.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvgConsumption
FROM (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
) t
JOIN (
    SELECT d.Segment, MIN(d.TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM (
        SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
        FROM yearmonth y
        JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
    ) d
    GROUP BY d.Segment
) m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND m.MinConsumption = t.TotalConsumption
GROUP BY t.Segment
),
q6 AS (
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) AS SME_LAM_Diff,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) AS LAM_KAM_Diff,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END) AS KAM_SME_Diff
FROM q5
)
SELECT SME_LAM_Diff, LAM_KAM_Diff, KAM_SME_Diff
FROM q6

WITH q1 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T.team_api_id, T.team_long_name
    FROM Match AS M
    JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = M.home_team_api_id
    WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
      AND M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal
),
q2 AS (
    SELECT T.team_api_id, T.team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS home_losses
    FROM Match AS M
    JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = M.home_team_api_id
    WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
      AND M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal
    GROUP BY T.team_api_id, T.team_long_name
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT MIN(t.home_losses) AS min_home_losses
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS home_losses
        FROM Match
        WHERE season = '2015/2016'
          AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal
        GROUP BY home_team_api_id
    ) AS t
),
q4 AS (
    SELECT T.team_long_name
    FROM Match AS M
    JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = M.home_team_api_id
    WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
      AND M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal
    GROUP BY T.team_api_id, T.team_long_name
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT MIN(sub.cnt)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM Match
            WHERE season = '2015/2016'
              AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal
            GROUP BY home_team_api_id
        ) AS sub
    )
)
SELECT q2.team_long_name
FROM q2
JOIN q3 ON q2.home_losses = q3.min_home_losses

WITH q1 AS (
SELECT c.id AS country_id, c.name AS country_name, p.player_api_id AS player_id, p.player_name, p.weight
FROM Match m
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
),
q2 AS (
SELECT country_id, country_name, AVG(weight) AS avg_player_weight
FROM q1
GROUP BY country_id, country_name
),
q3 AS (
SELECT
    country_id,
    country_name,
    MAX(avg_player_weight) AS max_avg_player_weight
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.id AS country_id,
        c.name AS country_name,
        AVG(p.weight) AS avg_player_weight
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
)
SELECT q2.country_id, q2.country_name, q2.avg_player_weight AS max_avg_player_weight
FROM q2
JOIN q3 ON q2.avg_player_weight = q3.max_avg_player_weight

SELECT molecule_id, label
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '+'
),
q2 AS (
SELECT atom.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom
JOIN q1 ON atom.molecule_id = q1.molecule_id
GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
),
q3 AS (
SELECT MAX(t.atom_count) AS max_atom_count
FROM (
    SELECT atom.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
    FROM atom
    JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
) AS t
),
q4 AS (
SELECT atom.molecule_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(atom.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(t.atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT a.molecule_id AS mol_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
        FROM atom a
        JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
        WHERE m.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a.molecule_id
    ) AS t
)
)
SELECT q4.molecule_id
FROM q4

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cz.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 cz
    JOIN min_seg ms
      ON cz.Segment = ms.Segment
     AND cz.total_consumption = ms.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE ma.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T3.link_to_event
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
JOIN attendance AS T3 ON T1.member_id = T3.link_to_member
WHERE T2.approved = 'true'
  AND T2.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT m.email
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > 20
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT COUNT(m.member_id) AS num_members
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'education'
  AND mj.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

SELECT m.major_name, m.department
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Garrett' AND mem.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT T1.city
FROM zip_code AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.zip
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T2.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
GROUP BY superhero.id, superhero.full_name
HAVING COUNT(superhero.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT s.superhero_name, s.height_cm
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage_bad,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM hero_power AS T1
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(id) * 1.0 / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT T1.height_cm
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id 
INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT superhero_name, SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) FROM superhero GROUP BY superhero_name;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_patient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Date, strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(SUBSTR(Patient.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' 
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = 9 AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T2.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.`First Date` = T1.`Examination Date`;

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.`ANA` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET DISEASE'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT CAST(julianday(e.`Examination Date`) - julianday(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'within normal range' ELSE 'not within normal range' END AS ALP_Status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT L.ID, L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday, Patient.Description, Patient.`First Date`, Patient.Admission, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID,
       CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS 'Albumin within normal range'
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA) AS avg_UA
FROM (
    SELECT L.ID, L.UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.ID ORDER BY L.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory L
) T
JOIN Patient P ON T.ID = P.ID
WHERE T.rn = 1
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (l.FG NOT BETWEEN 150 AND 450);

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID) 
FROM Examination 
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900 
  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000 
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS t1
JOIN Examination AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND t2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2) 
  AND T2.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.`SC170` IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
  AND L.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T1."aCL IgA" = (
      SELECT MAX(T3."aCL IgA")
      FROM Examination AS T3
      JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID
      WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND bond.bond_type = '-'

SELECT SUM(atom.element = 'c') / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY atom.element
LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id;

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) t

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to CZK-paying customers
    SELECT y.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312   -- Year 2013 constraint
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- The lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption customer(s)
    --                  / number of customers at that lowest level, per segment
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_average
    FROM czk_2013 AS t
    JOIN min_per_segment AS m
      ON m.Segment = t.Segment
     AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_average ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_average ELSE 0 END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_average ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_average ELSE 0 END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_average ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_average ELSE 0 END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM annual_avg;

  AND c.Currency = 'Euro'
  AND y.Date = 201310
ORDER BY y.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c
  ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date = 201305
  AND c.Segment = 'KAM';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS PercentageOfKAMUsingEuro
FROM customers
WHERE Segment = 'KAM';

SELECT MAX(monthly_consumption) AS biggest_monthly_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) / 12.0 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
) AS per_customer;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN transactions_1k AS t
    ON y.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN products AS p
    ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'   -- first 4 characters = year
  AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 5, 2) = '09';    -- 5th and 6th characters = month (09 = September)

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM gasstations AS g
JOIN transactions_1k AS t
    ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
JOIN yearmonth AS y
    ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 5, 2) = '06';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
FROM customers AS c
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y
    ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.Consumption > 1000;

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y
    ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
ORDER BY y.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00';

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date LIKE '%201306%'
  AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT c.Currency AS Nationality
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24'
  AND t.Price = 548.4;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) * 100.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage_eur_customers
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c
    ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT SUM(T2.Price) AS amount_spent
FROM yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Date = '201201'
  AND T1.CustomerID = 38508;

SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
    c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c 
    ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
WHERE substr(pa.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND pa.overall_rating > (
        SELECT AVG(pa2.overall_rating)
        FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
        WHERE substr(pa2.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
      )
  AND pa.overall_rating = (
        SELECT MAX(pa3.overall_rating)
        FROM Player_Attributes AS pa3
        WHERE substr(pa3.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
      );

SELECT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50
  AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T
  ON TA.team_fifa_api_id = T.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
        SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
        JOIN Team AS T2
          ON TA2.team_fifa_api_id = T2.team_fifa_api_id
        WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
          AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
      );

SELECT
    SUM(pa.long_shots) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
        SELECT SUM(TA2.chanceCreationPassing) / COUNT(TA2.id)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
        WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
          AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
          AND TA2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT pa.heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND pa.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id = (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY birthday DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT l.name
FROM League AS l
JOIN Country AS c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT
    SUM(Match.home_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM Match
JOIN Country
    ON Match.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Poland'
  AND Match.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', PA.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', Match.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (
    SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
    FROM Player_Attributes
);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
