ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L 
    ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT L.name AS league_name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.match_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T1.overall_rating) / COUNT(T1.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT DISTINCT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) AS highest_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT pa.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND pa.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT AVG(PA.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P
    ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND substr(PA.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
WHERE (
    SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T2.height DESC)
    FROM Player AS T2
    WHERE T1.id = T2.id
) = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (
      M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
      M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
      M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
      M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
      M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
      M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
  )
JOIN Country C
  ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Match m
  ON pa.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
        m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10,
        m.away_player_11
     )
JOIN Country c
  ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name AS country
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
    m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10,
    m.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(p.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(t.avg_w)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS avg_w
        FROM Player p2
        JOIN Match m2 ON p2.player_api_id IN (
            m2.home_player_1, m2.home_player_2, m2.home_player_3, m2.home_player_4,
            m2.home_player_5, m2.home_player_6, m2.home_player_7, m2.home_player_8,
            m2.home_player_9, m2.home_player_10, m2.home_player_11,
            m2.away_player_1, m2.away_player_2, m2.away_player_3, m2.away_player_4,
            m2.away_player_5, m2.away_player_6, m2.away_player_7, m2.away_player_8,
            m2.away_player_9, m2.away_player_10, m2.away_player_11
        )
        JOIN Country c2 ON c2.id = m2.country_id
        GROUP BY c2.name
    ) t
);

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT AVG(P.height) AS Avg_height
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (
      M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
      M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
      M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
      M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
      M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
      M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
  )
JOIN Country AS C
  ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.stamina > 80 AND pa.strength > 80 THEN pa.player_api_id END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id) AS percentage_of_players
FROM Player_Attributes pa;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_percentage_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c
  ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp    dp ON c.client_id  = dp.client_id
JOIN account a  ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d  ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, d.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', account.date) = '1996';

SELECT DISTINCT
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS d
    ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district AS dt
    ON dt.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'          -- account holder's region: east Bohemia
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'                -- account holder = the person who OWNS the account
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';  -- years 1995 to 2000

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name,
       SUM(l.amount) AS total_active_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY total_active_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    d.A2  AS district_name,
    d.A13 AS unemployment_rate_1996
FROM district d
WHERE d.A13 = (
    SELECT MAX(A13)
    FROM district
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan AS l
INNER JOIN account AS a
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'          -- hard constraint: monthly statement issuance
  AND l.amount >= 250000                        -- loans of at least 250,000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'  -- issued between 1/1/1995 and 12/31/1997
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');                   -- approved loans (no problems: finished OK or running OK)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" AS o
JOIN account AS a
    ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.bank = 'AB'
  AND LOWER(d.A3) = 'north bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
  AND c.gender = 'M';

SELECT c.type
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE d.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
          / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '97' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
INNER JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM district;

SELECT strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.account_id = 130
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS debt_amount,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status,
    l.date AS loan_date
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'withdrawal'
  AND t.date LIKE '1998%';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND account.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.duration = 24
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT event.event_name
FROM event
JOIN attendance ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
GROUP BY event.event_id, event.event_name
HAVING COUNT(attendance.link_to_event) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(link_to_event) AS cnt
        FROM attendance
        GROUP BY link_to_event
    ) AS attendance_counts
);

SELECT COUNT(e.event_id) AS num_events
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND YEAR(e.event_date) = 2019;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_events
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND event_id IN (
      SELECT link_to_event
      FROM attendance
      GROUP BY link_to_event
      HAVING COUNT(link_to_event) > 10
  );

SELECT
    e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a
    ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(e.event_id) > 20;

SELECT
    1.0 * COUNT(event.event_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT event.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event
JOIN attendance
    ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.type = 'Meeting'
  AND YEAR(event.event_date) = 2020;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent_on_food
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Meeting'
  AND b.category = 'Food';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';

SELECT notes
FROM income
WHERE source = 'Fundraising'
  AND date_received = '2019-09-14';

SELECT phone
FROM member
WHERE first_name = 'Carlo'
  AND last_name = 'Jacobs';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS exceeded_budget_count
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'November Meeting'
  AND budget.remaining < 0;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.source = 'Dues'
ORDER BY T2.date_received ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN b.category = 'Parking' AND e.event_name = 'November Speaker' THEN b.amount
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) * 100.0
  /
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN e.event_name = 'November Speaker' THEN e.event_name
    END
  ) AS percentage
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b
  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy'
  AND m.last_name = 'Firth';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS maryland_members
FROM member
JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
WHERE zip_code.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_meeting_events_2020
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND YEAR(event_date) = 2020;

SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget AS b
    ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS ev
    ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT CAST(SUM(major_name = 'Finance') AS REAL) / SUM(major_name = 'Physics') AS ratio
FROM major;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Community Service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(event_id) AS percentage_share
FROM event
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31';

SELECT t_shirt_size
FROM member
GROUP BY t_shirt_size
HAVING COUNT(t_shirt_size) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(t_shirt_size) AS cnt
        FROM member
        GROUP BY t_shirt_size
    ) AS size_counts
);

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
  AND b.remaining < 0
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY MIN(b.remaining) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    b.category,
    SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;

SELECT budget_id
FROM budget
WHERE category = 'Food'
  AND amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food');

SELECT major.major_name
FROM major
JOIN member ON major.major_id = member.link_to_major
WHERE member.first_name = 'Phillip'
  AND member.last_name = 'Cullen';

SELECT DISTINCT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'Vice President';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income WHERE amount = 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS major_count
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT zip_code.city, zip_code.state
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
WHERE major.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT DISTINCT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    a.link_to_event
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a
    ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN expense AS e
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT m.email
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND e.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS num_members
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Education'
  AND ma.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m 
    ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget AS b 
    ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS ev 
    ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name
ORDER BY
    MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.college
FROM member AS T1
JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id
WHERE T1.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT
    e.event_name,
    SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT z.city
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett'
  AND m.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT
    s.superhero_name AS name,
    s.height_cm,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage_bad,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM hero_power AS T1
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'strength'
  );

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name AS hero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c_eye.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c_skin ON s.skin_colour_id = c_skin.id
JOIN colour c_eye ON s.eye_colour_id = c_eye.id
WHERE c_skin.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS difference;

SELECT
    superhero_name,
    SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name, id
ORDER BY superhero_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.id = 1;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero sh
JOIN alignment a ON sh.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sh.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    / COUNT(*)
    * 100.0 AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN gender    ON superhero.gender_id    = gender.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT s.id AS hero_id
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT T1.ID, SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(T1.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4)) - MIN(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    T1.Date, 
    STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CAST(
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL
    ) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', L.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4'
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT P.`Diagnosis` AS original_diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E
    ON P.`ID` = E.`ID`
WHERE E.`Diagnosis` = 'SLE'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT ( AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) ) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Description, Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = 48473
  AND SEX = 'F';

SELECT CAST(SUM(SEX = 'F') AS REAL) / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' 
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet disease' 
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT DATEDIFF(`Examination Date`, `First Date`) AS evaluation_delay
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT
    P.ID,
    CASE
        WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND (l.ALB <= 3.5 OR l.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
       T1.ID,
       CASE
           WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS AlbuminWithinNormalRange
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
     ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p
     ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) m
     ON l.ID = m.ID AND l.Date = m.max_date
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5);

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND p.ID IN (
      SELECT l.ID
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.UN < 30
  );

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT
    p.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_list
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT T1.ID,
       T1.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2
  ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)
                    FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY T2.`Birthday` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)

  AND atom.element = 'cl';

    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type

SELECT

SELECT m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id

WHERE a.element = 'pb'

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id AS atom_id

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T.bond_id) AS REAL) * 100
       / (SELECT COUNT(T2.atom_id) FROM connected AS T2) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T
JOIN atom AS A1 ON A1.atom_id = T.atom_id
JOIN atom AS A2 ON A2.atom_id = T.atom_id2
GROUP BY A1.element, A2.element
HAVING COUNT(T.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(sub.atom_cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(C.atom_id) AS atom_cnt
        FROM connected AS C
        JOIN atom AS D1 ON D1.atom_id = C.atom_id
        JOIN atom AS D2 ON D2.atom_id = C.atom_id2
        GROUP BY D1.element, D2.element
    ) AS sub
);

WITH YearTotal AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
MinSeg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM YearTotal
    GROUP BY Segment
),
Lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, t.TotalConsumption
    FROM YearTotal t
    JOIN MinSeg m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM Lowest

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, c.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumption,
           COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS NumCustomers
    FROM totals AS t
    WHERE t.TotalConsumption = (
        SELECT MIN(t2.TotalConsumption)
        FROM totals AS t2
        WHERE t2.Segment = t.Segment
    )
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption * 1.0 / NumCustomers AS AnnualAverage
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

SELECT p.ID, l.ALB, CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory AS L2 WHERE L2.ID = L.ID)
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;
SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY p.SEX

SELECT P.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.APTT > 45 AND E.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CAST(U-PRO AS REAL) >= 30);
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Laboratory."U-PRO" > 0 AND Laboratory."U-PRO" < 30
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.IGG > 900 AND T1.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Laboratory INNER JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y',Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+'
SELECT Patient.ID FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 1 AND Laboratory.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Examination WHERE SM IN ('-', '+-') AND Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative','0')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Examination.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Examination.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient."First Date") AS INTEGER) < 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE CAST(Laboratory.GOT AS REAL) >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(T3.LDH) FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3.LDH < 500);
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB = (SELECT MAX(ALB) FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5 AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5 AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T3."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND Examination."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.TG < 200 ORDER BY Laboratory.TG DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(atom.element = 'c') / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element FROM connected JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected

JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;
SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '-' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-') ORDER BY molecule_id LIMIT 3

SELECT bond_id, bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'

LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (

    GROUP BY b.molecule_id

SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected)

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom_id1, a2.atom_id AS atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND bond.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(bond.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(connected.bond_id)
                FROM connected
                JOIN atom a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
                JOIN atom a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
                GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
                ORDER BY COUNT(connected.bond_id) DESC
                LIMIT 1)
             / (SELECT COUNT(connected.bond_id) FROM connected)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) = 2

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.label = '-'

SELECT T1.bond_id, T2.label
FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'

GROUP BY atom.element;
SELECT DISTINCT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'

SELECT SUM(bond_type = ' = ') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 1 AND T2.atom_id = 1

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.label = 'TR006'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl'

SELECT atom.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_type) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = 'TR346' GROUP BY atom.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT T3.label FROM atom AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
SELECT DISTINCT atom.molecule_id FROM atom JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 's' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '+' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.molecule_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.School
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.CDSCode
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500;

SELECT T2.District
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds)

JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.County = 'Alameda'

FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING SUM(t.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(t.cds) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (

      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT T2.School,
       T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T1.County = 'Fresno'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC

SELECT s.School, f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31

      SELECT MAX(f2."Enrollment (K-12)")

SELECT T2.sname, T1.MailStreet
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1

WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT T1.Website

WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Larson')

SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.Charter = 0 AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Hickman' AND T1.CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly Funded'

SELECT T1.County FROM schools AS T1 WHERE T1.CDSCode IN (SELECT T2.CDSCode FROM schools AS T2 WHERE T2.SOC = 11 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989') GROUP BY T1.County ORDER BY COUNT(T1.CDSCode) DESC LIMIT 1

WHERE T1.City = 'Adelanto'

ORDER BY COUNT(T1.GSserved) DESC

SELECT p.Title

WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS answer_count
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId

SELECT posts.Body

SELECT COUNT(b.Id)

JOIN badges b1 ON b1.UserId = u.Id AND b1.Name = 'Teacher'
JOIN badges b2 ON b2.UserId = u.Id AND b2.Name = 'Supporter'

SELECT T1.UserId
FROM postHistory AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY T1.UserId, T1.PostId
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1

WITH CommentCounts AS (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(Id) AS Cnt
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
),
TopUsers AS (
    SELECT cc.UserId
    FROM CommentCounts cc
    JOIN (
        SELECT MAX(Cnt) AS MaxCnt
        FROM CommentCounts
    ) m ON cc.Cnt = m.MaxCnt
)
SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, b.Name AS Badge
FROM TopUsers t
JOIN users u ON t.UserId = u.Id
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id;

SELECT t1.PostHistoryTypeId, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.UserId) AS unique_users
FROM postHistory t1
JOIN comments t2 ON t1.PostId = t2.PostId
WHERE t1.PostId = 3720
GROUP BY t1.PostHistoryTypeId;

SELECT posts.Score, postLinks.LinkTypeId
FROM posts
JOIN postLinks ON posts.Id = postLinks.PostId
WHERE posts.Id = 395;

       SUM(T1.Age) / COUNT(T1.Id) AS avg_age

    JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id)
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(s.id) AS bad_percentage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT DISTINCT publisher.id
FROM publisher
JOIN superhero ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Star Trek';

SELECT COUNT(T1.id)
FROM superhero AS T1
LEFT JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.full_name IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T2.race = 'Alien'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE race.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185 AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT superhero.superhero_name, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(publisher.publisher_name) AS percent
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT SUM(a.weight_kg) - SUM(b.weight_kg) AS weight_difference
FROM superhero a
JOIN superhero b ON b.full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
WHERE a.full_name = 'Emil Blonsky';

SELECT s.superhero_name,
       SUM(h.height_cm) / COUNT(h.id) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN superhero h
  ON s.id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name;

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id)
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.id = 1;

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
LEFT JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT alignment.alignment, superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.id) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id
JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.id = 2

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' 
AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT superhero.id)
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero.superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT T1.id
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
ORDER BY T2.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT superhero.id FROM superhero JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.Admission = '+' THEN T1.ID END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS percentage_inpatient
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT T1.ID, SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), YEAR(T1.Birthday)) AS age FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT
  (SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(p.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER))
   FROM Patient p
   WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT l.ID FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.TG >= 200))
  -
  (SELECT MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(p.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER))
   FROM Patient p
   WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT l.ID FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.TG >= 200));

SELECT
    (SELECT T1.Date
     FROM Laboratory AS T1
     WHERE T1.ID = (SELECT T2.ID
                    FROM Patient AS T2
                    WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
                    ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
                    LIMIT 1)) AS Lab_Date,
    (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday)
     FROM Patient AS T2
     WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
     ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
     LIMIT 1) AS Age_At_First_Arrival;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;
SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT e."aCL IgM"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND e."Examination Date" = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T2.SEX
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.GPT = '9' AND T1.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', l.Date) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4'
  AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(T1.Birthday) = 1964
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT T2.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY T2.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.Description, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 48473 AND T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', BIRTHDAY) = '1980')
  AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND P.Admission = '-'

SELECT DATEDIFF(`Examination Date`, `First Date`)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(T2.LDH) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Normal
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';
SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5
SELECT T1.* FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(T2.UA)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(T3.Date)
    FROM Laboratory AS T3
    WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
)
AND ((T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA < 8.0) OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA < 6.5));

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS Result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0 AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5 AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) < 70

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE RF < 20
  );
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 0 AND T1.ID IN (SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-'))

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND YEAR(T1.`First Date`) < 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T2.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.Date
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ALB > 3.5 AND T1.ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY T1.ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T3.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT t1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS t1
JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t2.TG < 200
ORDER BY t2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
GROUP BY b.bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT ROUND(
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id),
         3
       ) AS percent
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM molecule
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
      AND molecule.molecule_id = (
          SELECT bond.molecule_id
          FROM bond
          WHERE bond.bond_type = ' = '
          GROUP BY bond.molecule_id
          ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
          LIMIT 1
      )
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.atom_id IS NULL;

SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(T1.bond_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE (T2.element, T3.element) IN (
    SELECT T5.element, T6.element
    FROM connected AS T4
    JOIN atom AS T5 ON T4.atom_id = T5.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS T6 ON T4.atom_id2 = T6.atom_id
    GROUP BY T5.element, T6.element
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT MAX(t.cnt)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM connected AS T7
            JOIN atom AS T8 ON T7.atom_id = T8.atom_id
            JOIN atom AS T9 ON T7.atom_id2 = T9.atom_id
            GROUP BY T8.element, T9.element
        ) AS t
    )
);

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 AS REAL) / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.element)
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'c';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total) AS sum_total, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total = mt.min_total
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT 1.0 * sum_total / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT 1.0 * sum_total / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM,
    (SELECT 1.0 * sum_total / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT 1.0 * sum_total / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT 1.0 * sum_total / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT 1.0 * sum_total / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME;

    SELECT MAX(cnt)

        SELECT COUNT(a2.atom_id) AS cnt

        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'

);

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotal
    FROM CustomerTotals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS AnnualAverageConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotals ct
    JOIN MinConsumption mc
      ON ct.Segment = mc.Segment
     AND ct.TotalConsumption = mc.MinTotal
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAverageConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverageConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverageConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverageConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverageConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverageConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_minus_SME

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
),
player_weights AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.country_id, a.player_api_id, p.weight
    FROM appearances a
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
    WHERE a.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
),
country_avgs AS (
    SELECT country_id, AVG(weight) AS avg_weight
    FROM player_weights
    GROUP BY country_id
)
SELECT c.name, ca.avg_weight
FROM country_avgs ca
JOIN Country c ON c.id = ca.country_id
WHERE ca.avg_weight = (SELECT MAX(avg_weight) FROM country_avgs);

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
  * 100.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
  AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (1996, 1997);
