SELECT l.loan_id,
       l.status,
       l.amount,
       l.duration,
       l.payments,
       ROUND(l.amount * 1.0 / l.duration, 1) AS expected_monthly_payment,
       CASE
         WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 'Finished - paid regularly, no debt'
         WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'Finished - NOT paid, debt remains'
         WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 'Running - paying regularly, on track'
         WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 'Running - falling behind, in debt'
       END AS payment_standing,
       CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B', 'D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END AS debt_amount,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l2.amount), 0)
          FROM loan l2
         WHERE l2.account_id IN (SELECT d2.account_id
                                   FROM disp d2
                                  WHERE d2.client_id = 992)
           AND l2.status IN ('B', 'D')) AS total_debt
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id
                         FROM disp d
                        WHERE d.client_id = 992);

WITH pair_counts AS (
    SELECT MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS element1,
           MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS element2,
           COUNT(*) AS bond_count
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element)
),
max_pair AS (
    SELECT bond_count
    FROM pair_counts
    ORDER BY bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
totals AS (
    SELECT COUNT(bond_id) AS total_bonds
    FROM bond
)
SELECT (SELECT bond_count FROM max_pair) * 100.0
     / (SELECT total_bonds FROM totals) AS percentage;

lowest_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(annual_consumption) AS lowest_consumption
    FROM customer_annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_average AS (
    SELECT ca.Segment,
           SUM(ca.annual_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM customer_annual ca
    JOIN lowest_per_segment l
      ON l.Segment = ca.Segment AND ca.annual_consumption = l.lowest_consumption
    GROUP BY ca.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT COUNT(bond.bond_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(mycount)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS mycount
        FROM connected
        JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
    ) AS counts
);

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT l.loan_id,
       l.amount,
       l.payments,
       l.duration,
       l.status,
       l.amount - l.payments *
         ((CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER) * 12 + CAST(strftime('%m', date('now')) AS INTEGER)) -
          (CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) * 12 + CAST(strftime('%m', l.date) AS INTEGER))) AS remaining_debt
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT AVG(t.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT l.ID, l.UA
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
        FROM Laboratory
        GROUP BY ID
    ) m ON l.ID = m.ID AND l.Date = m.max_date
    WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
       OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
) t;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) = '1997' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END))
   * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) 
   - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 
   / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_consumers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, t.CustomerID, t.TotalConsumption
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment
     AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvgConsumption
    FROM lowest_consumers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END), 2) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END), 2) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvgConsumption END), 2) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM segment_avg;

    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_1996,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_1997
    FROM loan l

           WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'Contract finished, loan not paid'

        WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
        WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
        WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
        WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
        WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'
        WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
        WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
        ELSE a.element

WITH czk_customers AS (
    -- Customers who paid in CZK
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
customer_year_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, with their segment
    SELECT y.CustomerID,
           cz.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN czk_customers cz
      ON y.CustomerID = cz.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, cz.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM customer_year_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_consumers AS (
    -- Customers with the least consumption per segment:
    -- sum their consumption and count how many there are
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(c.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumption,
           COUNT(*)                AS NumCustomers
    FROM customer_year_consumption c
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON c.Segment = m.Segment
     AND c.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
annual_averages AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT Segment,
           TotalConsumption * 1.0 / NumCustomers AS AnnualAverage
    FROM lowest_consumers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT C.name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_matches

SELECT League.name AS league_name

SELECT P.player_name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a

    ON a.district_id = d.district_id

    ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'

SELECT
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_customers
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

WITH oldest_female AS (
    -- Step 1: Find the oldest female client(s) (earliest birth_date = oldest)
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                        FROM client
                        WHERE gender = 'F')
),
oldest_female_salary AS (
    -- Step 2: Get their account(s) and the average salary (A11) of their district
    SELECT d.account_id, dn.A11
    FROM oldest_female o
    JOIN disp d      ON d.client_id = o.client_id
    JOIN district dn ON dn.district_id = o.district_id
)
-- Step 3: Keep only the lowest average salary among them, and
-- Step 4: Compute gap = highest average salary (overall max A11) - this lowest salary
SELECT DISTINCT
    s.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - s.A11 AS salary_gap
FROM oldest_female_salary s
WHERE s.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM oldest_female_salary);

SELECT account_id
FROM loan
WHERE duration > 12
  AND status = 'C'   -- 'C' = running contract, OK so far (approved)
  AND account_id IN (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM account
        WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1993'
  )
  AND amount = (
        SELECT MAX(amount)
        FROM loan
        WHERE duration > 12
          AND status = 'C'
          AND account_id IN (
                SELECT account_id
                FROM account
                WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1993'
          )
  );

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id

SELECT T1.date

JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts

SELECT a.account_id, a.date

JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) AS num_accounts

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01'
               THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3 AS region
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.client_id = 3541;

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp    ON disp.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id  = disp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 *
        (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
        /
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END),
        2
    ) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM disp   AS d
        JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
        WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      )
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT

SELECT strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount            AS debt_amount,        -- loan amount the client owes
    l.payments          AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration          AS duration_months,
    l.status            AS status_code,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Loan finished, no problems - all payments made'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Loan finished, but NOT paid off - debt remains'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Loan still running, payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Loan still running, client IN DEBT (behind on payments)'
    END                 AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT
    -- Count of male in-patients
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_inpatient_count,
    -- Count of male outpatients
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatient_count,
    -- Which group is larger
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'More in-patients'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'More outpatients'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS comparison,
    -- Deviation percentage: in-patients / outpatients
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- Pair each bond with the elements of its two atoms
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.bond_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id2 = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- Count how many bonds exist per element combination
    SELECT element1, element2, COUNT(bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY element1, element2
)
-- Percentage = bonds with the most common element combo / total bonds
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(bond_count) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts;

    -- UserId(s) where COUNT(Id) equals the MAX of all counts
    SELECT UserId, CommentCount
    FROM CommentCounts
    WHERE CommentCount = (SELECT MAX(CommentCount) FROM CommentCounts)
)

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer who pays in CZK
    SELECT y.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    -- Keep only the customer(s) with the LEAST consumption in each segment,
    -- then total their consumption and count how many they are
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalLowestConsumption,
           COUNT(*)                AS NumLowestCustomers
    FROM czk_2013 t
    WHERE t.TotalConsumption = (
        SELECT MIN(t2.TotalConsumption)
        FROM czk_2013 t2
        WHERE t2.Segment = t.Segment
    )
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption per year / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT Segment,
           TotalLowestConsumption * 1.0 / NumLowestCustomers AS AnnualAvgConsumption
    FROM lowest_per_segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT

    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM disp dp
JOIN client   c ON c.client_id   = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female(s): smallest birth_date (later birthdate => younger person)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
  -- among the oldest female(s), keep the lowest average salary (A11)
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (

                FROM client

FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT alignment.alignment, superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) * 100.0 AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(superhero.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE race.race <> 'Human'
  AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute
WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value)
                         FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT superhero.id
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_patient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_inpatient
FROM Patient
WHERE year(Birthday) BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT
    Patient.ID,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RVVT = '+';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER))
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    T1.Date AS Laboratory_Work_Date,
    YEAR(T2.`First Date`) - YEAR(T2.Birthday) AS Age_At_First_Arrival
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - YEAR(P.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT SUBTRACT(YEAR(L.Date), YEAR(P.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P
  ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4'
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS num_female_patients,
       GROUP_CONCAT(ID ORDER BY ID) AS patient_ids
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Thrombosis` = 2
  AND T2.`ANA` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination)
                    + (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 0.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND P.Admission = '-'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND E."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997';

SELECT DATEDIFF(`Examination Date`, `First Date`) AS days_before_evaluation
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - outside normal range'
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.*
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.Date,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE YEAR(P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) latest ON l.ID = latest.ID AND l.Date = latest.max_date
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT
    p.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID,
       L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)      -- highest total cholesterol
  AND P.Birthday = (SELECT MIN(P2.Birthday)                  -- oldest among those patients
                    FROM Patient AS P2
                    JOIN Laboratory AS L2
                         ON L2.ID = P2.ID
                    WHERE L2.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory));

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND L.FG NOT BETWEEN 150 AND 450;

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND L.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900
  AND L.IGG < 2000
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.RA IN ('-', '+-')    -- normal Rheumatoid Factor
  AND T2.KCT = '+';           -- positive measure of degree of coagulation

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(P.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination
JOIN Laboratory
  ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SM IN ('-', '+-')   -- normal anti-SM
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;    -- does not have thrombosis

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND YEAR(Patient.`First Date`) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) AS REAL)
    / COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS percentage
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH = (
    SELECT MAX(LDH)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH < 500
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS male_patients_normal_alb_tp
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
WHERE E."aCL IgA" = (
        SELECT MAX("aCL IgA")
        FROM Examination
      )
  AND E.ID IN (
        SELECT L.ID
        FROM Laboratory AS L
        WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
      );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND Examination.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
HAVING COUNT(bond_type) = (
    SELECT MAX(COUNT(bond_type))
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY bond_type
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_chlorine
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded_carcinogenic
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule  AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id     = b.bond_id
JOIN atom      AS a ON a.atom_id     = c.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY atom.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    -
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond       ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected  ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'      -- molecule is not carcinogenic
  AND bond.bond_type = '-'      -- bond is a single bond
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id   -- alphabetical order (top three)
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'not carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '          -- hard requirement: double bonds only
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) DESC
    LIMIT 1                             -- molecule with the most double bonds
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id  FROM connected c)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c);

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND a.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom pb ON pb.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a  ON a.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
WHERE pb.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom pb ON pb.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN atom a  ON a.atom_id  = c.atom_id
WHERE pb.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element AS element1,
           a2.element AS element2,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS combo_counts;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS num_elements
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'yes'
         ELSE 'no'
       END AS has_both_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element AS toxicology_element,
       COUNT(a.element) AS tally
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes, carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'No, not carcinogenic'
    END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_bonds
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM atom 
        WHERE element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM bond 
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
      );

SELECT
    b.bond_id,
    m.label,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
         ELSE 'not carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT molecule_id
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id IN ('TR000_2', 'TR000_4')
GROUP BY molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT atom_id) = 2;

SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    label,
    CASE 
        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id,
       COUNT(atom.molecule_id) AS num_atoms
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id

WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (CZK only)
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y 
        ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of lowest consumers / count of them
    SELECT 
        yc.Segment,
        SUM(yc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(yc.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearly_consumption AS yc
    JOIN min_per_segment AS m 
        ON yc.Segment = m.Segment 
       AND yc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY yc.Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') 
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') 
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') 
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT PA.heading_accuracy
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND PA.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY p.birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT AVG(m.home_team_goal) AS avg_home_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Poland'
  AND m.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', PA.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_api_id, p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa 
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', Match.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT Player.player_name
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
GROUP BY Player.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(Player_Attributes.overall_rating) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT P.player_name, MAX(PA.crossing) AS max_crossing
    FROM Player AS P
    JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
        ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
    WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
    GROUP BY P.player_name
) AS T
ORDER BY T.max_crossing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match AS M 
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id 
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' 
  AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT L.name AS league_name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T1.overall_rating) / COUNT(T1.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT DISTINCT PA.preferred_foot
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) AS highest_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT PA.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND PA.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND Player_Attributes.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND SUBSTR(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) m ON p.player_api_id = m.player_id
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON pa.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
     )
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name AS country
FROM Match M
JOIN Player P
  ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,
                         M.home_player_4,  M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,
                         M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,  M.home_player_9,
                         M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
                         M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,
                         M.away_player_4,  M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,
                         M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,  M.away_player_9,
                         M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country C
  ON C.id = M.country_id
GROUP BY C.id, C.name
ORDER BY AVG(P.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT AVG(P.height) AS avg_height
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
        M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
        M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
        M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
        M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
        M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
     )
JOIN Country AS C
  ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN 1995 
        ELSE 1996 
    END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT d.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - di.A11 AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp    d  ON c.client_id    = d.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female client(s): earliest birth date
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                      FROM client
                      WHERE gender = 'F')
  -- among them, the one(s) with the lowest average salary
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(di2.A11)
                FROM client c2
                JOIN district di2 ON c2.district_id = di2.district_id
                WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
                  AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                       FROM client
                                       WHERE gender = 'F'));

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(amount)
      FROM loan
      WHERE duration > 12
  );

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21'
);

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND a.date LIKE '1996%';

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d 
    ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c 
    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt 
    ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name,
       SUM(l.amount) AS total_active_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')   -- 'C' = running contract, 'D' = running contract / in debt
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY total_active_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT A3 AS branch_location,
       A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.district_id = 1
  AND loan.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trans.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND trans.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_issued_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3 AS region
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 100.0 * 
       COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d   ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount          AS loan_amount,
    l.payments        AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration        AS duration_months,
    l.status,
    l.amount - (l.payments * COUNT(t.trans_id)) AS remaining_debt
FROM client c
JOIN disp d 
    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN loan l 
    ON l.account_id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t 
    ON t.account_id = l.account_id 
    AND t.k_symbol = 'UROK'   -- 'UROK' marks loan payments in this schema
WHERE c.client_id = 992
GROUP BY 
    c.client_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.payments, l.duration, l.status;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1998%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1996;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS loan_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.client_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card AS cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT attendance.link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendance
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT DISTINCT m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT T1.event_name
FROM event AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
GROUP BY T1.event_id, T1.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.link_to_member) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(e.event_id) AS num_events
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2019';

SELECT COUNT(event_id) AS num_meetings
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND event_id IN (
      SELECT link_to_event
      FROM attendance
      GROUP BY link_to_event
      HAVING COUNT(link_to_member) > 10
  );

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_event) > 20;

SELECT 
    COUNT(event.event_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT event.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event
JOIN attendance 
    ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
WHERE event.type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', event.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_food_spending
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Food'
  AND e.event_name = 'September Meeting';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';

SELECT notes
FROM income
WHERE source = 'Fundraising'
  AND date_received = '2019-09-14';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS exceeded_budgets
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'November Meeting'
  AND budget.remaining < 0;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
INNER JOIN income i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
WHERE i.source = 'Dues'
ORDER BY i.date_received ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Parking' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount) * 100 AS parking_percentage
FROM budget
JOIN event ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event
WHERE event_name = 'November Speaker';

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy' AND m.last_name = 'Firth';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS members_from_maryland
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_events_2020
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2020';

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(m.first_name, ' ', m.last_name) AS full_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense ex ON m.member_id = ex.link_to_member
JOIN budget b   ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT 
    SUM(m.major_name = 'Finance') / SUM(m.major_name = 'Physics') AS ratio
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id;

SELECT t_shirt_size
FROM member
GROUP BY t_shirt_size
ORDER BY COUNT(t_shirt_size) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT event.event_name
FROM event
JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event
WHERE event.status = 'Closed'
  AND budget.remaining < 0
ORDER BY budget.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    b.category,
    SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;

SELECT category, MAX(amount) AS highest_budgeted_amount
FROM budget
WHERE category = 'Food'
GROUP BY category;

SELECT m.major_name
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Phillip'
  AND mem.last_name = 'Cullen';

SELECT DISTINCT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'Vice President';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_majors
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE mj.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT DISTINCT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone

SELECT major.major_name, major.department

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name, major.college

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS average

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race

SELECT T1.height_cm

SELECT s.full_name

SELECT publisher.publisher_name

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name

FROM Patient

SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - above normal range'
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p

       L.TP,

ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

       CASE

       END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS avg_UA

        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID          -- restrict to each patient's latest lab exam

        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)   -- normal range for males
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)   -- normal range for females
      );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS Answer

SELECT

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday)

SELECT MIN(T2.`First Date`)

    ORDER BY T1.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1

SELECT Date

  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)

SELECT p.Diagnosis

SELECT bond_type

GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM bond AS b
     JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'          -- carcinogenic molecules
      AND b.bond_type = '-') * 1.0   -- single bonds

  (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM atom AS a
     JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+')         -- atoms in carcinogenic molecules
  AS avg_single_bonds;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2

SELECT element

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+')

    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT element

                      UNION

    ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id

SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id2

JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id

    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt

    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element

JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';
SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM member WHERE position = 'Secretary'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Community Service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(event_id) FROM event WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
SELECT t_shirt_size FROM member GROUP BY t_shirt_size ORDER BY COUNT(t_shirt_size) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.status = 'Closed' AND T2.remaining < 0 ORDER BY T2.remaining ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.category, SUM(T1.amount) FROM budget AS T1 JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T2.event_name = 'April Speaker' GROUP BY T1.category ORDER BY SUM(T1.amount) ASC
SELECT budget_id, category, spent, remaining, amount, event_status, link_to_event FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food' AND amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food');
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Parking';
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20';
SELECT major.major_name FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE member.first_name = 'Phillip' AND member.last_name = 'Cullen'

SELECT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Business';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
SELECT T1.category FROM budget AS T1 JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T2.event_date = '2020-03-24T12:00:00'
SELECT major.major_name FROM major JOIN member ON major.major_id = member.link_to_major WHERE member.position = 'Vice President'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income WHERE amount = 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM major WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences' AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE mj.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member' AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';
SELECT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Game' AND status = 'Closed' AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, a.link_to_event
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT member.email
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE expense.cost > 20
  AND expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Education'
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND member.position = 'Member';
SELECT expense_description FROM expense GROUP BY expense_description HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(T1.cost) / COUNT(T3.event_id)
FROM expense AS T1
JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id
JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
JOIN member AS T4 ON T1.link_to_member = T4.member_id
WHERE T4.position != 'Member';

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name
FROM member
JOIN expense ON member.member_id = expense.link_to_member
GROUP BY member.member_id, member.first_name, member.last_name
ORDER BY SUM(expense.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT first_name, last_name, phone
FROM member
WHERE member_id IN (
    SELECT link_to_member
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)
);

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT member.last_name, member.phone
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT member.first_name || ' ' || member.last_name AS full_name, major.college
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent, e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT T1.city
FROM zip_code AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T2.zip = T1.zip_code
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T2.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY superhero.height_cm DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  );

       SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_comics_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek'
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id = 75

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T2.race = 'Alien'
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND colour = 'No Colour'
SELECT superhero.full_name FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE race.race = 'Demi-God' LIMIT 5

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185 AND r.race = 'human';
SELECT T2.power_name FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T1.hero_id = 1

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT superhero.superhero_name, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT superhero.height_cm FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber'

SELECT DISTINCT c2.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;
SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
