SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' AND s.superhero_name = 'Hulk';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id JOIN race AS T3 ON T1.race_id = T3.id WHERE T3.race <> 'Human' AND T2.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute)
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';
SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.id = 40;
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT superhero.id FROM superhero JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT p.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'in-patient'
    ELSE 'outpatient'
  END AS more_frequent,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_patient_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';
SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5;
SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)

SELECT L.Date, (strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(SUBSTR(Patient.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT YEAR(L.Date) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4' AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.ANA = 'S' AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2

SELECT Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND Laboratory.CRP > 2
  AND Laboratory.CRE = 1
  AND Laboratory.LDH = 123;
SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`)
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT P.ID, CASE WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.Birthday FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, L.ALB,
       CASE WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range' ELSE 'Out of normal range' END AS AlbuminStatus
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT l.ID, l.UA, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory l
) T
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = T.ID
WHERE T.rn = 1
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.CRE >= 1.5) > (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.CRE >= 1.5);
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY p.SEX

SELECT P.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."U-PRO" >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND l.`U-PRO` < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGG > 900 AND l.IGG < 2000 AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2 AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND `SC170` IN ('negative', '0');
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SCL70 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL
SELECT MAX(Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT >= 60)
SELECT MIN(T1."First Date") FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 AND T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T1."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX(T3."aCL IgA") FROM Examination AS T3 JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory AS L JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND E."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR004_8_9' UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR004_8_9')

SELECT T3.atom_id, T3.atom_id2
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;
SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id LIMIT 2;
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT T2.molecule_id, CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+' AND T2.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND T2.Segment = 'SME')
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(T2.Segment)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND T2.Segment = 'SME')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND T2.Segment = 'LAM')
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(T2.Segment)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND T2.Segment = 'LAM')
UNION ALL

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.Date = 201310
ORDER BY y.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth AS T1
JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Date = 201305 AND T2.Segment = 'KAM';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN y.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS Percentage
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'Euro' THEN c.CustomerID END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS Percentage
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM';

SELECT MAX(T2.Consumption)
FROM customers AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012';

SELECT MAX(monthly_consumption) AS biggest_monthly_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
) AS t;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN transactions_1k t ON ym.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE ym.Date = 201309;

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON y.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE y.Date = '201306';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.Date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date LIKE '%201306%' AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT Currency
FROM customers
WHERE CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-24'
      AND Price = 548.4
);

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT SUM(t.Price) AS total_spent
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.CustomerID = 38508
  AND t.Date = '201201';

SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
    c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top ON c.CustomerID = top.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency;

SELECT P.player_api_id
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(PA.overall_rating) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name, P.height
FROM Player P
JOIN (SELECT MAX(height) AS max_height FROM Player) M
  ON P.height = M.max_height;

SELECT PA.preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.potential ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_api_id
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN (
    SELECT home_team_api_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal - away_team_goal < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
    FROM Match
    WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id
) M ON T.team_api_id = M.home_team_api_id
ORDER BY M.losses ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_api_id
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE substr(T2.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND T2.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010')
  AND T2.overall_rating > (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010');

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_fifa_api_id = ta.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND ta.buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(PA.long_shots) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) AS avg_chanceCreationPassing
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
      AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
) AS A ON TA.chanceCreationPassing < A.avg_chanceCreationPassing
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate

SELECT PA.heading_accuracy

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating)

WHERE Player_Attributes.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'

FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id

FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id

FROM Player p
JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS rnk
    FROM Player

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT name
FROM Country
WHERE id IN (
    SELECT country_id
    FROM Match
    JOIN Player ON Player.player_api_id IN (
        Match.home_player_1, Match.home_player_2, Match.home_player_3, Match.home_player_4, Match.home_player_5,
        Match.home_player_6, Match.home_player_7, Match.home_player_8, Match.home_player_9, Match.home_player_10,
        Match.home_player_11, Match.away_player_1, Match.away_player_2, Match.away_player_3, Match.away_player_4,
        Match.away_player_5, Match.away_player_6, Match.away_player_7, Match.away_player_8, Match.away_player_9,
        Match.away_player_10, Match.away_player_11
    )
    GROUP BY country_id
    HAVING AVG(Player.weight) = (
        SELECT MAX(avg_weight)
        FROM (
            SELECT AVG(P2.weight) AS avg_weight
            FROM Match M2
            JOIN Player P2 ON P2.player_api_id IN (
                M2.home_player_1, M2.home_player_2, M2.home_player_3, M2.home_player_4, M2.home_player_5,
                M2.home_player_6, M2.home_player_7, M2.home_player_8, M2.home_player_9, M2.home_player_10,
                M2.home_player_11, M2.away_player_1, M2.away_player_2, M2.away_player_3, M2.away_player_4,
                M2.away_player_5, M2.away_player_6, M2.away_player_7, M2.away_player_8, M2.away_player_9,
                M2.away_player_10, M2.away_player_11
            )
            GROUP BY M2.country_id
        )
    )
);

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT AVG(DISTINCT p.height)
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (

FROM Player p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
ORDER BY p.player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND l.loan_id IS NULL;

SELECT
    AVG(d1.A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(d1.A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(d1.A12) > AVG(d1.A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district d1
JOIN district d2 ON d1.district_id = d2.district_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(d2.A11) FROM district d2) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date) FROM client c2 WHERE c2.gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d3.A11)
        FROM client c3
        JOIN district d3 ON c3.district_id = d3.district_id
        WHERE c3.gender = 'F'
          AND c3.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c4.birth_date) FROM client c4 WHERE c4.gender = 'F')
  );

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND a.date LIKE '1996%';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district t ON t.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND t.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.A3 AS branch_location, d.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN (SELECT MAX(A13) AS max_unemployment_rate FROM district) m
  ON d.A13 = m.max_unemployment_rate;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND d.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A15 = (
      SELECT A15
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id

  AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_women
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100
    AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT n.total_crimes - e.total_crimes AS crime_difference
FROM
    (SELECT SUM(A16) AS total_crimes FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') AS n
CROSS JOIN
    (SELECT SUM(A16) AS total_crimes FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS e;

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.disp_id = 130 AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT loan.amount, loan.payments, loan.duration, loan.status
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE client.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'withdrawal'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', t.date) AS INTEGER) = 1998;

SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id)
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T2.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) > 96;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.duration = 24 
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' 
  AND loan.status = 'A';

SELECT c.client_id, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students
FROM attendance
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_member) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(e.event_id)
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_meetings
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'

HAVING COUNT(e.event_id) > 20;

FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting' AND YEAR(e.event_date) = 2020;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code

FROM income
WHERE income_id IN (
    SELECT income_id

);
SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs';

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT COUNT(*)

FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

FROM expense e

WHERE e.expense_description = 'Pizza';

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
FROM member m

SELECT COUNT(*) AS maryland_members
FROM member
JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
WHERE zip_code.state = 'Maryland';
SELECT COUNT(e.event_id) FROM event e WHERE e.type = 'Meeting' AND YEAR(e.event_date) = 2020;

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id

FROM member m

LIMIT 1;

SELECT event.event_name
FROM event
JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event
WHERE event.status = 'Closed'

FROM budget b
INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'

SELECT budget.budget_id, budget.category, budget.amount
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE budget.category = 'Food'
  AND budget.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food');

SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_expense
FROM expense e
LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id

SELECT major.major_name

SELECT DISTINCT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member

FROM major m
WHERE m.college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'

FROM member m

JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.event_id, e.event_name
FROM expense exp
JOIN member m ON exp.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT DISTINCT member.email
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND expense.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
  AND mj.major_name = 'education'
  AND mj.college = 'College of Education & Human Services';

SELECT T1.expense_description
FROM expense AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id
GROUP BY T1.expense_description
HAVING SUM(T1.cost) / COUNT(T1.expense_id) > 50;

JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id

FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member

ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member

FROM member

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college

JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'

SELECT zip_code.city
FROM member
JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id

HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY superhero.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC

       SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_comics_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185 AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM hero_power AS T1
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'strength'
  );

SELECT superhero.superhero_name, race.race
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT eye_colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour AS skin_colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = skin_colour.id
JOIN colour AS eye_colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = eye_colour.id
WHERE skin_colour.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) 
   FROM superhero 
   JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
   JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id 
   WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' 
     AND gender.gender = 'Female') * 100.0 /
  (SELECT COUNT(*) 
   FROM superhero 
   JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
   WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS percent;

SELECT SUM(s1.weight_kg) - SUM(s2.weight_kg) AS difference
FROM superhero s1
JOIN superhero s2 ON s1.full_name <> s2.full_name
WHERE s1.full_name = 'Emil Blonsky' AND s2.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT s.superhero_name,
       SUM(s.height_cm) / COUNT(s.id) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
GROUP BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE publisher.id = 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT alignment.alignment, superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
WHERE hero_attribute.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(gender.id = 2) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT superhero.id) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT h.hero_id
FROM hero_attribute h
JOIN superhero s ON h.hero_id = s.id
WHERE h.attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT superhero.id
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) AS male_inpatient_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS male_outpatient_count,
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) /
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.Admission = '+' THEN P.ID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient P
LEFT JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday))
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT MIN(T1.Date) AS LabDate,
       YEAR(T2.`First Date`) - YEAR(T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
GROUP BY T2.ID, T2.Birthday, T2.`First Date`
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T2.Date) BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

SELECT `aCL IgM`
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
  AND ID = (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Patient
      WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
        AND Description = '1994-02-19'
  );
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'

SELECT SUBTRACT(YEAR(T1.Date), YEAR(T2.Birthday))
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p.`Diagnosis`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.`Diagnosis` = 'SLE';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(P.Birthday) = 1964
  AND P.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination)
                     + (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 0.2;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;
SELECT MAX(T1.Symptoms) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT P.Description, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = 48473;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.SEX) AS percentage
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE YEAR(p.Birthday) = '1980' AND p.Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT DATEDIFF(e.`Examination Date`, p.`First Date`) AS evaluation_delay
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(T2.LDH) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500;

SELECT T1.ID,
       CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT P.ID, L.Date, L.TP, (L.TP - 8.5) AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT Patient.*
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT ID,
       CASE WHEN ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Albumin_Normal
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1982');

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) latest
    ON l.ID = latest.ID AND l.Date = latest.latest_date
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5);

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
ORDER BY T1.`T-CHO` DESC, T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.APTT > 45
  AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T3.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND YEAR(Patient.`First Date`) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.DNA < 8
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
)
AND ALB > 3.5
AND ALB < 5.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.CRE < 1.5
  AND e."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
GROUP BY b.bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(atom.element = 'c') * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.bond_id, b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE
    WHEN (SELECT label
          FROM molecule
          WHERE molecule_id = (
              SELECT molecule_id
              FROM bond
              WHERE bond_type = ' = '
              GROUP BY molecule_id
              ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
              LIMIT 1
          )) = '+'
    THEN 'yes'
    ELSE 'no'
END;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.atom_id IS NULL;

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id, a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(T1.bond_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
    OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c'
  AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM bond
   WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006')
     AND bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count,
  (SELECT label
   FROM molecule
   WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') AS carcinogenic;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT connected.bond_id)
FROM connected
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 's'
LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE a.atom_id IS NULL
  AND b.bond_id IS NULL;

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.molecule_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.molecule_id) AS cnt
        FROM molecule m2
        JOIN atom a2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY m2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT
    `School Name`,
    `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
  AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT satscores.sname
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND schools.Magnet = 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT schools.District
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY schools.District
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    T2.sname,
    T1.CharterNum,
    T2.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND T1.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T2.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School, T2.FundingType
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND s.EILName = 'High'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT 
    frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' 
  AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT 
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    sc.City
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.MailStreet, T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 6, 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2
  ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE (T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500
  AND T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport';

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Mike'
  AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson'
  AND AdmFName2 = 'Dante'
  AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez';

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) AS total_schools
FROM schools
WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman'
  AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) 
FROM schools 
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' 
  AND County = 'Stanislaus' 
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '12/31/2005';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    sc.School,
    sc.District,
    fr.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / fr.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS fr
JOIN schools AS sc
    ON fr.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND fr.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND fr.`High Grade` = '9';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.City,
    f.`Low Grade`,
    f.`School Name`
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode), T2.City, COUNT(T2.City)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY T2.City;

SELECT 
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
    f.`District Code`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

SELECT 
    T1.AdmEmail1, 
    T1.AdmEmail2, 
    T1.AdmEmail3
FROM schools AS T1
WHERE T1.County = 'San Bernardino'
    AND T1.City = 'San Bernardino'
    AND T1.District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
    AND T1.OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'

WITH per_customer AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK-paying customer, with their segment
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS ym
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customer(s) with the least consumption in each segment
    SELECT pc.Segment, pc.total_consumption
    FROM per_customer AS pc
    JOIN min_per_segment AS mps
      ON pc.Segment = mps.Segment
     AND pc.total_consumption = mps.min_consumption
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;
