    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS difference;

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM superhero;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT
    a.alignment,
    s.power_name
FROM superhero sh
JOIN alignment a
    ON sh.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp
    ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
JOIN superpower s
    ON s.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sh.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero
JOIN colour 
    ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment 
    ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.id 
FROM superhero AS T1 
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id 
INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id 
WHERE T3.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS in_patient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS outpatient_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) > 
             COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) 
            THEN 'More in-patients'
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) < 
             COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) 
            THEN 'More outpatients'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS comparison,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) / 
          COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID,
       STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E
    ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200;

SELECT 
    T2.Date AS lab_date,
    strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(L.UA AS REAL) <= 8.0 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(L.UA AS REAL) <= 6.5 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + (AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2)
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' 
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' 
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT DATEDIFF(`Examination Date`, `First Date`) AS Days_Until_Examination
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = '821298';

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.TP, T1.TP - 8.5 AS deviation_of_TP_from_normal
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SEX = 'F'
  AND T1.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID,
       CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS Albumin_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(T1.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(Date)
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE ID = T1.ID
      )
  AND (
        (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
     OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID, 
    Patient.SEX, 
    Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory 
    ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT 
    SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    T1.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY T1.SEX;

SELECT 
    P.ID AS patient_id,
    L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) 
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.APTT > 45
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
  ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE Patient.Description IS NULL
  AND Patient.ID IN (
      SELECT Laboratory.ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Description = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND YEAR(P.`First Date`) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Examination.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b     ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a     ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS T1
WHERE T1.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-';

SELECT element
FROM (
    SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
    GROUP BY element
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 3
) AS top3
ORDER BY element;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'        -- single bond
  AND m.label = '-'            -- not carcinogenic
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
           ELSE 'Not carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes (carcinogenic)' 
            ELSE 'No (non-carcinogenic)' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS top_molecule ON m.molecule_id = top_molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b  ON c.bond_id  = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' 
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM atom AS a1
JOIN connected AS c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'pb';

SELECT CAST(MAX(pair_count) AS REAL) * 100.0
       / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS element_combos;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
        5
    ) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS has_both_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a 
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-'
  AND T1.label = '-';

SELECT 
    bond.bond_id,
    bond.molecule_id,
    molecule.label AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond
JOIN molecule 
    ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
       m.label AS carcinogenic_label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT  a.atom_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM    molecule m
JOIN    atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE   m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT T3.label
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 
    ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

WITH continuation_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE EdOpsName = 'Continuation Education'
),
eligible_rates AS (
    SELECT f.CDSCode,
           f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN continuation_schools AS c ON f.CDSCode = c.CDSCode
)
SELECT eligible_free_rate
FROM eligible_rates
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH high_test_takers AS (
    SELECT
        s.sname,
        sc.Magnet
    FROM satscores AS s
    JOIN schools AS sc
        ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
)
SELECT DISTINCT sname
FROM high_test_takers
WHERE Magnet = 1;

WITH TopSchool AS (
    SELECT T1.CDSCode
    FROM schools AS T1
    JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
    ORDER BY T2.NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
JOIN TopSchool AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.CDSCode;

WITH school_enrollment AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, `Enrollment (K-12)`, `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
    FROM frpm
),
total_enrollment AS (
    SELECT CDSCode,
           `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS TotalEnrollment
    FROM school_enrollment
)
SELECT CDSCode
FROM total_enrollment
WHERE TotalEnrollment > 500;

WITH active_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
),
active_scores AS (
    SELECT T1.dname, T1.AvgScrRead
    FROM satscores AS T1
    INNER JOIN active_schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
),
district_avg AS (
    SELECT dname, AVG(AvgScrRead) AS avg_read
    FROM active_scores
    GROUP BY dname
)
SELECT dname
FROM district_avg
ORDER BY avg_read DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH merged_alameda AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'Alameda'
      AND StatusType = 'Merged'
),
test_takers AS (
    SELECT cds, sname, NumTstTakr
    FROM satscores
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM merged_alameda AS m
JOIN test_takers AS t ON m.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr < 100;

WITH avg_writing AS (
    SELECT s.cds, s.sname, AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write
    FROM satscores s
    GROUP BY s.cds, s.sname
    HAVING AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) > 499
),
valid_charter AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, CharterNum
    FROM schools
    WHERE CharterNum IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT aw.sname, vc.CharterNum, aw.avg_write
FROM avg_writing aw
JOIN valid_charter vc ON aw.cds = vc.CDSCode
ORDER BY aw.avg_write DESC;

WITH riverside_avg_math AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School AS sname, AVG(sc.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sc ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
    GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School
)
SELECT ram.sname, s.FundingType
FROM riverside_avg_math ram
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = ram.CDSCode
WHERE ram.avg_math_score > 400;

WITH monterey_high_frpm AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, `School Name`
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `County Name` = 'Monterey'
      AND `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
),
high_schools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE f.`High Grade` IN ('9', '10', '11', '12')
)
SELECT h.School, h.Street, h.City, h.State, h.Zip
FROM high_schools AS h
JOIN monterey_high_frpm AS m ON h.CDSCode = m.CDSCode;

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS avg_enrollment_difference
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
),
enrollment_diff AS (
    SELECT s.School,
           s.DOCType,
           f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS Enrollment_Difference
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
)
SELECT DISTINCT e.School, e.DOCType
FROM enrollment_diff AS e
CROSS JOIN avg_diff AS a
WHERE e.Enrollment_Difference > a.avg_enrollment_difference;

WITH Ranked AS (
    SELECT `School Name`,
           `Free Meal Count (K-12)`,
           `Enrollment (K-12)`,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC) AS rnk
    FROM frpm
),
Target AS (
    SELECT `School Name`,
           `Free Meal Count (K-12)`,
           `Enrollment (K-12)`,
           rnk
    FROM Ranked
    WHERE rnk IN (10, 11)
)
SELECT `School Name`,
       rnk,
       `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate`
FROM Target;

WITH kacey_school AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
       OR (AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
       OR (AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
),
free_meal_count AS (
    SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS free_count
    FROM frpm
    JOIN kacey_school ON frpm.CDSCode = kacey_school.CDSCode
),
enrollment AS (
    SELECT frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS enrollment_count
    FROM frpm
    JOIN kacey_school ON frpm.CDSCode = kacey_school.CDSCode
)
SELECT free_meal_count.free_count / enrollment.enrollment_count AS `Free Rate`
FROM free_meal_count
CROSS JOIN enrollment;

WITH chartered_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, `Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
),
min_enrollment_school AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM chartered_schools
    ORDER BY enrollment ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT schools.AdmEmail1
FROM schools
JOIN min_enrollment_school ON schools.CDSCode = min_enrollment_school.CDSCode;

WITH fresno_schools_1980 AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'Fresno'
      AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'
),
test_takers AS (
    SELECT s.sname, s.NumTstTakr
    FROM fresno_schools_1980 f
    JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
)
SELECT AVG(NumTstTakr) AS avg_num_test_takers
FROM test_takers;

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT sname, cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
INNER JOIN top_school AS T3 ON T1.cds = T3.cds;

WITH state_special_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE DOC = 31
),
enrollment AS (
    SELECT f.`School Name`, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN state_special_schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
),
max_enrollment AS (
    SELECT MAX(`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS max_enr
    FROM enrollment
)
SELECT e.`School Name`
FROM enrollment e
CROSS JOIN max_enrollment m
WHERE e.`Enrollment (K-12)` = m.max_enr;

WITH seventh_highest_math AS (
    SELECT cds, sname
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY AvgScrMath DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
)
SELECT sh.sname AS "School Name",
       sc.MailStreet AS "Postal Street"
FROM seventh_highest_math sh
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = sh.cds;

WITH total_scores AS (
    SELECT cds, sname, AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS total_score
    FROM satscores
),
qualifying_schools AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM total_scores
    WHERE total_score >= 1500
),
lakeport_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE MailCity = 'Lakeport'
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying_schools
JOIN lakeport_schools ON qualifying_schools.cds = lakeport_schools.CDSCode;

WITH mike_larson AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
       OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
       OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
),
dante_alvarez AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
       OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
       OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
)
SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
WHERE s.CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM mike_larson)
  AND s.CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM dante_alvarez)
  AND s.CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm)
  AND s.CDSCode IN (SELECT cds FROM satscores);

WITH san_joaquin_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School, Website
    FROM schools
    WHERE City = 'San Joaquin'
),
charter_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School
    FROM schools
    WHERE Charter = 1
),
partial_virtual_charter_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School
    FROM schools
    WHERE Charter = 1 AND Virtual = 'P'
)
SELECT sj.Website
FROM san_joaquin_schools sj
JOIN partial_virtual_charter_schools pvc
    ON sj.CDSCode = pvc.CDSCode;

WITH la_noncharter AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'Los Angeles'
      AND Charter = 0
),
meal_counts AS (
    SELECT CDSCode,
           `Free Meal Count (K-12)`,
           `Enrollment (K-12)`
    FROM frpm
),
low_free_rate AS (
    SELECT m.CDSCode
    FROM meal_counts AS m
    INNER JOIN la_noncharter AS s
        ON m.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE m.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / m.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
)
SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) AS total_schools
FROM low_free_rate;

WITH hickman_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman'
),
charter_00D4_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE CharterNum = '00D4'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools
FROM hickman_schools h
JOIN charter_00D4_schools c ON h.CDSCode = c.CDSCode;

WITH opened_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School, County, FundingType
    FROM schools
    WHERE OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
),
stanislaus_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'Stanislaus'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM opened_schools AS T1
JOIN stanislaus_schools AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.FundingType = 'Directly Funded';

WITH closed_1980s AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, County
    FROM schools
    WHERE SOC = 11
      AND ClosedDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS school_count
    FROM closed_1980s
    GROUP BY County
)
SELECT County
FROM county_counts
ORDER BY school_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH la_k9_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'Los Angeles'
      AND GSserved = 'K-9'
),
frpm_stats AS (
    SELECT CDSCode,
           `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`,
           `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`,
           `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
    FROM frpm
)
SELECT s.School AS `School Name`,
       f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM la_k9_schools AS s
JOIN frpm_stats AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode;

WITH adelanto_schools AS (
    SELECT School, GSserved
    FROM schools
    WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
),
grade_span_counts AS (
    SELECT GSserved, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
    FROM adelanto_schools
    GROUP BY GSserved
)
SELECT GSserved
FROM grade_span_counts
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH LowestLatSchool AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School, City
    FROM schools
    WHERE State = 'CA'
    ORDER BY Latitude ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
LowestGrade AS (
    SELECT f.CDSCode, f.`Low Grade`
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN LowestLatSchool AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
)
SELECT s.City,
       g.`Low Grade` AS Lowest_Grade,
       s.School
FROM LowestLatSchool AS s
JOIN LowestGrade AS g ON s.CDSCode = g.CDSCode;

WITH magnet_k8_multiple AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS magnet_multiple_count
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Magnet = 1
      AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
      AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
),
k8_city_counts AS (
    SELECT City, COUNT(CDSCode) AS school_count
    FROM schools
    WHERE GSoffered = 'K-8'
    GROUP BY City
)
SELECT
    (SELECT magnet_multiple_count FROM magnet_k8_multiple) AS num_magnet_multiple_provision_schools,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM k8_city_counts) AS num_cities,
    City,
    school_count
FROM k8_city_counts;

WITH alusine_school AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' OR AdmFName2 = 'Alusine' OR AdmFName3 = 'Alusine'
),
meal_data AS (
    SELECT f.CDSCode, f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN alusine_school AS a ON f.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
),
percent_free AS (
    SELECT CDSCode,
           `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
    FROM meal_data
),
district_code AS (
    SELECT f.CDSCode, f.`District Code`
    FROM satscores AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
    JOIN alusine_school AS a ON f.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
)
SELECT p.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, d.`District Code`
FROM percent_free AS p
JOIN district_code AS d ON p.CDSCode = d.CDSCode;

WITH san_bernardino_county AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
),
district_opened AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
      AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
),
school_types AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE SOC = '62'
      AND DOC = '54'
),
valid_emails AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail1 != ''
      AND AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail2 != ''
      AND AdmEmail3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail3 != ''
)
SELECT ve.AdmEmail1, ve.AdmEmail2, ve.AdmEmail3
FROM valid_emails ve
JOIN san_bernardino_county c ON ve.CDSCode = c.CDSCode
JOIN district_opened d ON ve.CDSCode = d.CDSCode
JOIN school_types st ON ve.CDSCode = st.CDSCode;

WITH MaxViews AS (
    SELECT MAX(Views) AS MaxViews
    FROM users
),
TopUserId AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE Views = (SELECT MaxViews FROM MaxViews)
)
SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users AS u
JOIN TopUserId AS t ON u.Id = t.Id;

WITH user_ids AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
),
user_posts AS (
    SELECT posts.Id, posts.Title
    FROM posts
    JOIN user_ids ON posts.OwnerUserId = user_ids.Id
)
SELECT DISTINCT Title
FROM user_posts;

WITH user_cte AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
),
csgillespie_posts AS (
    SELECT p.*
    FROM posts p
    JOIN user_cte u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
),
max_answers AS (
    SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) AS MaxAnswerCount
    FROM csgillespie_posts
)
SELECT MaxAnswerCount
FROM max_answers;

WITH wellFinishedPosts AS (
    SELECT Id, OwnerUserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
),
postOwners AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId
    FROM wellFinishedPosts
),
ownerUsers AS (
    SELECT Id, DisplayName
    FROM users
    WHERE Id IN (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM postOwners)
)
SELECT DisplayName
FROM ownerUsers;

WITH tag_row AS (
    SELECT Id, ExcerptPostId
    FROM tags
    WHERE TagName = 'bayesian'
)
SELECT p.Body
FROM posts p
JOIN tag_row tr ON p.Id = tr.ExcerptPostId;

WITH user_ids AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
),
user_badges AS (
    SELECT b.Id, b.Name, b.Date
    FROM badges b
    JOIN user_ids ui ON b.UserId = ui.Id
),
badges_2011 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Name
    FROM badges
    WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count
FROM user_badges ub
JOIN badges_2011 b11 ON ub.Name = b11.Name
WHERE strftime('%Y', ub.Date) = '2011';

WITH user_ids AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
),
user_posts AS (
    SELECT p.Score
    FROM posts p
    JOIN user_ids ui ON p.OwnerUserId = ui.Id
)
SELECT AVG(Score) AS AverageScore
FROM user_posts;

WITH target_post AS (
    SELECT Id, Title
    FROM posts
    WHERE ViewCount = 1910
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CommentCount
FROM comments
JOIN target_post ON comments.PostId = target_post.Id;

WITH target_posts AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    WHERE ParentId = 107829
      AND CommentCount = 1
),
single_comment_posts AS (
    SELECT PostId
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY PostId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
)
SELECT c.Text
FROM comments AS c
JOIN target_posts AS t ON c.PostId = t.Id
JOIN single_comment_posts AS s ON c.PostId = s.PostId;

WITH comment_user AS (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM comments
    WHERE Text = 'thank you user93!'
)
SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN comment_user cu ON u.Id = cu.UserId;

WITH target_post AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data'
),
editor_id AS (
    SELECT posts.LastEditorUserId
    FROM posts
    JOIN target_post ON posts.Id = target_post.Id
)
SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM editor_id
JOIN users ON users.Id = editor_id.LastEditorUserId;

WITH data_posts AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title LIKE '%data%'
),
bounty_votes AS (
    SELECT PostId, BountyAmount
    FROM votes
    WHERE BountyAmount IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT SUM(bv.BountyAmount) AS TotalBountyAmount
FROM bounty_votes bv
JOIN data_posts dp ON bv.PostId = dp.Id;

WITH variance_posts AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title LIKE '%variance%'
),
bounty_votes AS (
    SELECT v.UserId
    FROM votes v
    JOIN variance_posts vp ON v.PostId = vp.Id
    WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
)
SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN bounty_votes bv ON u.Id = bv.UserId;

WITH ny_users AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE Location LIKE '%New York%'
),
teacher_badge_users AS (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Teacher'
),
supporter_badge_users AS (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Supporter'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS num_users
FROM ny_users u
JOIN teacher_badge_users t ON t.UserId = u.Id
JOIN supporter_badge_users s ON s.UserId = u.Id;

WITH high_view_users AS (
    SELECT Id, DisplayName
    FROM users
    WHERE Views >= 1000
),
history_counts AS (
    SELECT UserId, PostId, COUNT(*) AS entry_count
    FROM postHistory
    GROUP BY UserId, PostId
),
multi_entry_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId
    FROM history_counts
    WHERE entry_count > 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM high_view_users u
JOIN history_counts hc ON hc.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Id NOT IN (SELECT UserId FROM multi_entry_users);

WITH CommentCounts AS (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(Id) AS CommentCount
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
),
TopCommentUser AS (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM CommentCounts
    ORDER BY CommentCount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN TopCommentUser t ON b.UserId = t.UserId;

WITH PostHistoryTypes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PostHistoryTypeId
    FROM postHistory
    WHERE PostId = 3720
),
UniqueCommenters AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId
    FROM comments
    WHERE PostId = 3720
),
CommenterCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS UniqueUserCount
    FROM UniqueCommenters
)
SELECT pht.PostHistoryTypeId,
       cc.UniqueUserCount
FROM PostHistoryTypes pht
CROSS JOIN CommenterCount cc;

WITH post_score AS (
    SELECT Id, Score
    FROM posts
    WHERE Id = 395
),
post_link_type AS (
    SELECT PostId, LinkTypeId
    FROM postLinks
    WHERE PostId = 395
)
SELECT ps.Score, plt.LinkTypeId
FROM post_score ps
JOIN post_link_type plt ON ps.Id = plt.PostId;

WITH PostCounts AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
),
UserAggregates AS (
    SELECT SUM(u.UpVotes) AS SumUpVotes,
           SUM(u.Age) AS SumAge,
           COUNT(u.Id) AS UserCount
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN PostCounts pc ON u.Id = pc.OwnerUserId
)
SELECT CAST(SumUpVotes AS REAL) / UserCount AS AvgUpVotes,
       CAST(SumAge AS REAL) / UserCount AS AvgAge
FROM UserAggregates;

WITH announcer_badges AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Announcer'
),
distinct_announcer_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId
    FROM announcer_badges
),
announcer_user_details AS (
    SELECT users.DisplayName
    FROM distinct_announcer_users
    JOIN users ON distinct_announcer_users.UserId = users.Id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS UsersWithAnnouncerBadge
FROM announcer_user_details;

WITH rochester_users AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE Location = 'Rochester, NY'
),
rochester_badges AS (
    SELECT Id, Date
    FROM badges
    WHERE UserId IN (SELECT Id FROM rochester_users)
)
SELECT Date
FROM rochester_badges;

WITH teacher_users AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) AS teacher_count
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Teacher'
),
all_users AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) AS total_count
    FROM badges
)
SELECT t.teacher_count * 100.0 / a.total_count AS percentage
FROM teacher_users t
CROSS JOIN all_users a;

WITH target_post AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    WHERE CreaionDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33.0'
),
post_comments AS (
    SELECT c.Id, c.Text
    FROM comments c
    JOIN target_post tp ON c.PostId = tp.Id
)
SELECT Text
FROM post_comments;

WITH vienna_users AS (
    SELECT Id, Age

           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
min_customers AS (
    SELECT czk.Segment,
           czk.CustomerID,
           czk.total_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 czk
    JOIN min_per_segment mps
      ON czk.Segment = mps.Segment
     AND czk.total_consumption = mps.min_consumption
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM min_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')

SELECT ct.CustomerID,
       ct.TotalPrice,
       ct.TotalAmount,
       ct.AvgPricePerItem,
       c.Currency
FROM CustomerTotals ct
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ct.CustomerID;

WITH max_rating AS (
    SELECT MAX(overall_rating) AS max_overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes
),
top_player AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT max_overall_rating FROM max_rating)

    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN top_player tp ON p.player_api_id = tp.player_api_id;

WITH MaxHeight AS (
    SELECT MAX(height) AS max_height
    FROM Player
)
SELECT p.player_name, p.height
FROM Player p
JOIN MaxHeight mh ON p.height = mh.max_height;

WITH MinPotential AS (
    SELECT MIN(potential) AS min_potential
    FROM Player_Attributes
),
TargetPlayers AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes pa

)
SELECT DISTINCT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN TargetPlayers tp
    ON pa.player_api_id = tp.player_api_id;

WITH player_crossing AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(crossing) AS max_crossing
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT player_api_id
FROM player_crossing
ORDER BY max_crossing DESC

WITH season_matches AS (
    SELECT id, home_team_api_id, home_team_goal, away_team_goal
    FROM Match
    WHERE season = '2015/2016'
),
team_losses AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS loss_count
    FROM season_matches
    WHERE home_team_goal < away_team_goal
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id
),
fewest_losses AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id
    FROM team_losses

    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT team_long_name
FROM Team

WITH avg_rating_2010 AS (
    SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
),
max_rating_2010 AS (
    SELECT MAX(overall_rating) AS max_overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
)
SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes pa
CROSS JOIN avg_rating_2010 ar
CROSS JOIN max_rating_2010 mr
WHERE substr(pa.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND pa.overall_rating > ar.avg_overall_rating
  AND pa.overall_rating = mr.max_overall_rating;

WITH speed_over_50 AS (

    WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50
),
speed_over_50_under_60 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM speed_over_50
    WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed < 60
)
SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id
FROM speed_over_50_under_60;

WITH avg_passing AS (
    SELECT SUM(TA.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T.team_long_name) AS avg_build_up_play_passing
    FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
    JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
    WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL

),
team_passing_2012 AS (
    SELECT TA.team_fifa_api_id, TA.buildUpPlayPassing
    FROM Team_Attributes AS TA

)
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM team_passing_2012 AS TP
JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_fifa_api_id = TP.team_fifa_api_id
CROSS JOIN avg_passing AS AP
WHERE TP.buildUpPlayPassing > AP.avg_build_up_play_passing;

WITH PlayerInfo AS (

),
PlayerLongShots AS (
    SELECT PA.long_shots, PA.player_fifa_api_id

    JOIN PlayerInfo AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
)
SELECT SUM(long_shots) / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) AS average_long_shots
FROM PlayerLongShots;

WITH tall_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_fifa_api_id, player_name
    FROM Player
    WHERE height > 180
),
heading_totals AS (
    SELECT player_fifa_api_id, SUM(heading_accuracy) AS total_heading_accuracy
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_fifa_api_id
),
heading_counts AS (
    SELECT player_fifa_api_id, COUNT(*) AS num_attributes
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_fifa_api_id
),
avg_heading AS (
    SELECT tp.player_name,
           ht.total_heading_accuracy * 1.0 / hc.num_attributes AS avg_heading_accuracy
    FROM tall_players tp
    JOIN heading_totals ht ON tp.player_fifa_api_id = ht.player_fifa_api_id
    JOIN heading_counts hc ON tp.player_fifa_api_id = hc.player_fifa_api_id
)
SELECT player_name
FROM avg_heading
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH normal_2014 AS (
    SELECT team_fifa_api_id, chanceCreationPassing
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
      AND date BETWEEN '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
),
avg_passing AS (
    SELECT SUM(chanceCreationPassing) * 1.0 / COUNT(id) AS avg_chance_creation_passing
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
      AND date BETWEEN '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
)
SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM normal_2014 AS N
JOIN Team AS T
    ON T.team_fifa_api_id = N.team_fifa_api_id
CROSS JOIN avg_passing AS A
WHERE N.chanceCreationPassing < A.avg_chance_creation_passing
ORDER BY N.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

WITH team_id AS (

    WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers'
),
team_api AS (
    SELECT t.team_api_id
    FROM Team t

)
SELECT t.team_short_name
FROM Team t
JOIN team_api ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';

WITH target_player AS (

),
player_attributes AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM target_player)

WITH target_player AS (

),
player_attributes_on_date AS (

WITH scotland_league AS (

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count

WITH youngest_player AS (

)

WITH netherlands AS (

    WHERE name = 'Netherlands'
),
netherlands_league AS (

    FROM League
    JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id

)

WITH poland_league AS (
    SELECT League.id

),
poland_matches AS (

    FROM Match M

)
SELECT SUM(home_team_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS avg_home_team_goal
FROM poland_matches;

WITH player_birth_years AS (
    SELECT player_name, strftime('%Y', birthday) AS birth_year
    FROM Player
),
players_born_1990 AS (
    SELECT player_name
    FROM player_birth_years
    WHERE birth_year = '1990'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_players
FROM players_born_1990;

WITH high_rated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE overall_rating > 80
      AND strftime('%Y', date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010'
)
SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name

WITH left_footed_players AS (

)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN left_footed_players lfp ON p.player_api_id = lfp.player_api_id;

WITH clb_team AS (

    WHERE team_short_name = 'CLB'
),
team_attributes AS (
    SELECT TA.id, TA.date, TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass

SELECT buildUpPlayPassingClass

WITH teams_with_high_passing AS (

),
active_teams AS (

WITH league_info AS (

WITH LeagueID AS (

),
FilteredMatches AS (

    WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM LeagueID)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count

WITH max_rating AS (
    SELECT MAX(overall_rating) AS max_overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes
),
top_player AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT max_overall_rating FROM max_rating)
)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN top_player tp ON p.player_api_id = tp.player_api_id;

WITH target_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_name
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
),
player_crossing AS (
    SELECT T1.player_name, MAX(T2.crossing) AS max_crossing

)
SELECT player_name

WITH belgium_league AS (

    FROM League
    WHERE name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_matches
FROM Match

WITH league_counts AS (
    SELECT league_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM Match
    WHERE season = '2008/2009'
    GROUP BY league_id
),
top_league AS (
    SELECT league_id
    FROM league_counts
    ORDER BY match_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT League.name

WITH born_before_1986 AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) < '1986'
),
ratings AS (
    SELECT PA.id, PA.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
    JOIN born_before_1986 AS B
        ON PA.player_api_id = B.player_api_id
)
SELECT SUM(overall_rating) / COUNT(id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM ratings;

WITH PlayerID AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'
),
PlayerAttr AS (
    SELECT PA.*
    FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
    INNER JOIN PlayerID ON PA.player_api_id = PlayerID.player_api_id
)
SELECT PAT.preferred_foot
FROM PlayerAttr AS PAT
INNER JOIN Player AS P ON P.player_api_id = PAT.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

WITH player AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'
),
ratings AS (
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
)
SELECT MAX(overall_rating) AS highest_overall_rating
FROM ratings;

WITH rated_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, P.birthday
    FROM Player_Attributes PA
    JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
    WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
      AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
),
min_birthday AS (
    SELECT MIN(birthday) AS oldest_birthday
    FROM rated_players
)
SELECT RP.player_name
FROM rated_players RP
JOIN min_birthday MB ON RP.birthday = MB.oldest_birthday;

WITH target_player AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
)
SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN target_player AS tp ON pa.player_api_id = tp.player_api_id
WHERE pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

WITH player AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
),
attribute_exists AS (
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Player_Attributes
        WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM player)
          AND date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'
    ) AS record_exists
)
SELECT defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM player)
  AND date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

WITH player AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
),
ratings AS (
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN player ON pa.player_api_id = player.player_api_id
    WHERE substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'
)
SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM ratings;

WITH MaxHeight AS (
    SELECT MAX(height) AS max_height
    FROM Player
),
Ranked AS (
    SELECT player_name,
           height,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS rank
    FROM Player
)
SELECT R.player_name
FROM Ranked R
JOIN MaxHeight M ON R.height = M.max_height;

WITH belgium AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM Country
    WHERE name = 'Belgium'
),
belgium_matches AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM Match
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM belgium)
),
belgium_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.player_api_id
    FROM Player p
    JOIN belgium_matches m ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN belgium_players bp ON p.player_api_id = bp.player_api_id;

WITH HighVisionPlayers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.player_api_id, P.player_name
    FROM Player P
    JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
    WHERE PA.vision > 89
),
HomeMatchCountries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN HighVisionPlayers hp
      ON hp.player_api_id IN (
          m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
          m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
          m.home_player_11
      )
),
AwayMatchCountries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.away_player_1  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
       OR m.away_player_2  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
       OR m.away_player_3  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
       OR m.away_player_4  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
       OR m.away_player_5  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
       OR m.away_player_6  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
       OR m.away_player_7  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
       OR m.away_player_8  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
       OR m.away_player_9  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
       OR m.away_player_10 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
       OR m.away_player_11 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM HighVisionPlayers)
),
MatchCountries AS (
    SELECT country_id FROM HomeMatchCountries
    UNION
    SELECT country_id FROM AwayMatchCountries
)
SELECT DISTINCT C.name AS country_name
FROM Country C
JOIN MatchCountries MC ON C.id = MC.country_id;

WITH player_weights AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.player_api_id, p.weight, m.country_id
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
),
avg_weights AS (
    SELECT country_id, AVG(weight) AS average_weight
    FROM player_weights
    GROUP BY country_id
),
heaviest_country AS (
    SELECT country_id
    FROM avg_weights
    ORDER BY average_weight DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN heaviest_country hc ON c.id = hc.country_id;

WITH slow_speed_teams AS (

),
match_teams AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_api_id FROM Match

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN slow_speed_teams AS S ON T.team_api_id = S.team_api_id
JOIN match_teams AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.team_api_id;

    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_1 FROM italy_matches

WITH tall_players AS (

    FROM Player
    WHERE height > 180
),
ordered_players AS (

    FROM tall_players
    ORDER BY player_name
)
SELECT player_name

LIMIT 3;

WITH matching_players AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE stamina > 80 AND strength > 80
),
total_players AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT mp.player_count * 100.0 / tp.player_count AS percentage
