CROSS JOIN total_players AS tp;

WITH prague_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'Prague'
),
prague_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE district_id IN (
        SELECT district_id
        FROM prague_districts
    )
),
loan_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM loan
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM prague_accounts AS pa
JOIN loan_accounts AS la
    ON pa.account_id = la.account_id;

WITH avg_1995 AS (
    SELECT AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995
    FROM district
),
avg_1996 AS (
    SELECT AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996
    FROM district
)
SELECT CASE 
           WHEN a.avg_unemployment_1995 > b.avg_unemployment_1996 THEN '1995' 
           ELSE '1996' 
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM avg_1995 a
CROSS JOIN avg_1996 b;

WITH salary_above_6000 AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A11 > 6000
),
salary_below_10000 AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A11 < 10000
),
female_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN salary_above_6000 s1
    ON d.district_id = s1.district_id
JOIN salary_below_10000 s2
    ON d.district_id = s2.district_id
JOIN female_districts f
    ON d.district_id = f.district_id;

WITH north_bohemia_high_salary AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'North Bohemia'
      AND A11 > 8000
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
WHERE gender = 'M' 
  AND district_id IN (
      SELECT district_id 
      FROM north_bohemia_high_salary
  );

WITH oldest_female AS (
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
),
oldest_female_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN oldest_female o ON d.client_id = o.client_id
),
salary_stats AS (
    SELECT MIN(A11) AS lowest_avg_salary, MAX(A11) AS highest_avg_salary
    FROM district
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       s.lowest_avg_salary,
       s.highest_avg_salary,
       s.highest_avg_salary - s.lowest_avg_salary AS salary_gap
FROM oldest_female_accounts a
CROSS JOIN salary_stats s;

WITH loans_over_12 AS (
    SELECT account_id, amount
    FROM loan
    WHERE duration > 12
),
max_amount AS (
    SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_approved_amount
    FROM loan
    WHERE duration > 12
),
accounts_1993 AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1993'
)
SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id
FROM loans_over_12 l
JOIN accounts_1993 a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT max_approved_amount FROM max_amount);

WITH accounts_before_1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE date < '1997-01-01'
),
latest_trans AS (
    SELECT account_id, balance
    FROM (
        SELECT account_id, balance,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC) AS rn
        FROM trans
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT a.account_id
FROM accounts_before_1997 a
JOIN latest_trans lt ON a.account_id = lt.account_id
WHERE lt.balance > 3000;

WITH transaction_840 AS (
    SELECT trans_id
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount = 840 AND date = '1998-10-14'
),
account_of_trans AS (
    SELECT t.account_id
    FROM trans t
    JOIN transaction_840 tr ON t.trans_id = tr.trans_id
)
SELECT a.date AS account_open_date
FROM account a
JOIN account_of_trans at ON a.account_id = at.account_id;

WITH card_disp AS (
    SELECT disp_id
    FROM card
    WHERE issued = '1996-10-21'
),
disp_account AS (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card_disp c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
)
SELECT MAX(t.amount)
FROM trans t
JOIN disp_account da ON t.account_id = da.account_id;

WITH litomerice AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
litomerice_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN litomerice l ON a.district_id = l.district_id
)
SELECT COUNT(account_id)
FROM litomerice_accounts
WHERE date LIKE '1996%';

WITH east_bohemia AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia'
),
accounts_1995_2000 AS (
    SELECT account_id, frequency, date, district_id
    FROM account
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'
),
owner_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id, account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE type = 'OWNER'
      AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan)
),
clients_info AS (
    SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, district_id
    FROM client
)
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM accounts_1995_2000 a
JOIN east_bohemia d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN owner_clients o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN clients_info c ON c.client_id = o.client_id;

WITH prachatice_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Prachatice'
),
prachatice_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM prachatice_district LIMIT 1)
),
account_info AS (
    SELECT account_id, date
    FROM account
)
SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account_info a
JOIN prachatice_accounts p ON a.account_id = p.account_id;

WITH max_active_loan AS (
    SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_amount
    FROM loan
    WHERE status IN ('C', 'D')
),
top_account AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN max_active_loan m ON l.amount = m.max_amount
    WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
),
top_district AS (
    SELECT a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN top_account t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
)
SELECT d.A3 AS district
FROM district d
JOIN top_district td ON d.district_id = td.district_id;

WITH district_unemployment AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2, A13
    FROM district
),
max_rate AS (
    SELECT MAX(A13) AS highest_unemployment_rate_1996
    FROM district_unemployment
)
SELECT du.district_id AS branch_location,
       du.A2 AS district_name
FROM district_unemployment du
JOIN max_rate mr
  ON du.A13 = mr.highest_unemployment_rate_1996;

WITH top_crime_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN top_crime_district t
    ON a.district_id = t.district_id;

WITH monthly_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
),
qualified_loans AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM loan
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
      AND amount >= 250000
),
approved_loans AS (
    SELECT loan_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'A' OR status = 'C'
)
SELECT l.account_id,
       COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans_count
FROM qualified_loans l
JOIN monthly_accounts a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN approved_loans al ON l.loan_id = al.loan_id
GROUP BY l.account_id;

WITH branch_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = '1'
),
branch_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN branch_district bd ON a.district_id = bd.district_id
),
status_c AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'C'
),
status_d AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'D'
),
running_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id FROM status_c
    UNION
    SELECT account_id FROM status_d
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ba.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM branch_accounts ba
JOIN running_accounts ra ON ba.account_id = ra.account_id;

WITH second_highest_crime_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
)
SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN second_highest_crime_district s
    ON c.district_id = s.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

WITH gold_card AS (
    SELECT disp_id
    FROM card
    WHERE type = 'gold'
),
owner_disp AS (
    SELECT disp_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE type = 'OWNER'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM gold_card
JOIN owner_disp ON gold_card.disp_id = owner_disp.disp_id;

WITH pisek_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Pisek'
),
pisek_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN pisek_district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
household_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM `order`
    WHERE k_symbol = 'SIPO'
)
SELECT DISTINCT pa.account_id
FROM pisek_accounts pa
JOIN household_orders ho ON pa.account_id = ho.account_id;

WITH gold_card_disp AS (
    SELECT disp_id
    FROM card
    WHERE type = 'gold'
),
disp_mapping AS (
    SELECT disp_id, account_id
    FROM disp
),
gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT dm.account_id
    FROM gold_card_disp g
    JOIN disp_mapping dm ON g.disp_id = dm.disp_id
)
SELECT a.*
FROM account a
JOIN gold_accounts ga ON a.account_id = ga.account_id;

WITH north_bohemia_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'North Bohemia'
),
nb_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM north_bohemia_districts)
),
ab_trans_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM trans
    WHERE bank = 'AB'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM nb_accounts a
JOIN ab_trans_accounts t ON a.account_id = t.account_id;

WITH praha_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN praha_district p ON c.district_id = p.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

WITH total_cards AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM card
),
gold_before_1998 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_count
    FROM card
    WHERE type = 'Gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01'
)
SELECT (g.gold_count * 100.0) / t.total_count AS percentage
FROM gold_before_1998 g, total_cards t;

WITH client_disp AS (
    SELECT disp_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 13539
),
client_cards AS (
    SELECT card_id
    FROM card
    WHERE disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM client_disp)
)
SELECT type
FROM card
WHERE card_id IN (SELECT card_id FROM client_cards);

WITH client_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id = 3541
)
SELECT d.A3 AS region
FROM district AS d
JOIN client_district AS cd
    ON d.district_id = cd.district_id;

WITH target_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A11 > 10000
),
district_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT disp.client_id, client.gender
    FROM disp
    JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
    WHERE account.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM target_districts)
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS female_percentage
FROM district_clients;

WITH male_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
),
loan_1996 AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.amount) AS amount_1996
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_accounts ma ON l.account_id = ma.account_id
    WHERE SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96'
),
loan_1997 AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.amount) AS amount_1997
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_accounts ma ON l.account_id = ma.account_id
    WHERE SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '97'
)
SELECT (l97.amount_1997 - l96.amount_1996) * 100.0 / l96.amount_1996 AS growth_rate
FROM loan_1996 l96
CROSS JOIN loan_1997 l97;

WITH north_bohemia_crimes AS (
    SELECT SUM(A16) AS total_crimes
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'North Bohemia'
),
east_bohemia_crimes AS (
    SELECT SUM(A16) AS total_crimes
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'East Bohemia'
)
SELECT
    n.total_crimes - e.total_crimes AS crime_difference
FROM north_bohemia_crimes n
JOIN east_bohemia_crimes e
    ON 1 = 1;

WITH owner AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 130 AND type = 'OWNER'
),
owner_birth AS (
    SELECT c.birth_date
    FROM client c
    JOIN owner o ON c.client_id = o.client_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM owner_birth;

WITH statement_freq_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
),
owner_dispositions AS (
    SELECT disp_id, account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE type = 'OWNER'
),
matching_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
    FROM account
    JOIN owner_dispositions ON account.account_id = owner_dispositions.account_id
    JOIN statement_freq_accounts ON account.account_id = statement_freq_accounts.account_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM matching_accounts;

WITH client_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 992
),
loan_info AS (
    SELECT l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status
    FROM loan l
    JOIN client_accounts ca ON l.account_id = ca.account_id
),
payment_info AS (
    SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid,
           COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
           MAX(t.date) AS last_payment_date
    FROM trans t
    JOIN client_accounts ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE t.k_symbol = 'UVER'
)
SELECT li.amount AS debt_amount,
       li.duration,
       li.payments,
       li.status,
       pi.total_paid,
       pi.transaction_count,
       pi.last_payment_date,
       li.amount - pi.total_paid AS remaining_debt
FROM loan_info li
CROSS JOIN payment_info pi;

WITH client_account AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 617
),
trans_1998 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_account)
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1998'
      AND type IN ('withdrawal', 'payment', 'VYDAJ')
)
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans_1998;

WITH beroun_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Beroun'
),
beroun_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.*
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN beroun_district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE a.date > '1996-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM beroun_accounts;

WITH weekly_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
loans_24_months AS (
    SELECT loan_id, account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE duration = 24
),
matching_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id
    FROM loans_24_months l
    JOIN weekly_accounts a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
)
SELECT COUNT(loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM matching_loans;

WITH gold_card AS (
    SELECT disp_id
    FROM card
    WHERE type = 'gold'
),
owner_disp AS (
    SELECT disp_id, client_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE type = 'OWNER'
),
eligible_client AS (
    SELECT d.client_id
    FROM owner_disp d
    JOIN gold_card g ON d.disp_id = g.disp_id
),
client_birth AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM eligible_client)
)
SELECT client_id,
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) AS age
FROM client_birth;

WITH engineering_majors AS (
    SELECT major_id
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Engineering'
),
engineering_students AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
    FROM member m
    JOIN engineering_majors em ON m.link_to_major = em.major_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students
FROM engineering_students;

WITH target_event AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
),
attendees AS (
    SELECT a.link_to_member
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN target_event AS te ON a.link_to_event = te.event_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendees;

WITH soccer_event AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
),
attendees AS (
    SELECT a.link_to_member
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN soccer_event se ON a.link_to_event = se.event_id
),
club_members AS (
    SELECT member_id, phone
    FROM member
)
SELECT cm.phone
FROM club_members cm
JOIN attendees att ON cm.member_id = att.link_to_member;

WITH attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
top_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event
    FROM attendance_counts
    ORDER BY attendee_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN top_event te ON e.event_id = te.link_to_event;

WITH sacha AS (
    SELECT member_id
    FROM member
    WHERE first_name = 'Sacha' AND last_name = 'Harrison'
),
attended_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T1.event_id
    FROM event AS T1
    JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
    JOIN sacha AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id
    WHERE YEAR(T1.event_date) = 2019
)
SELECT COUNT(event_id)
FROM attended_events;

WITH attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, e.type, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.type
),
popular_events AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM attendance_counts
    WHERE member_count > 10
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_count
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM popular_events);

WITH attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
high_attendance_events AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance_counts ac ON e.event_id = ac.event_id
    WHERE ac.member_count > 20
),
non_fundraiser_events AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name
    FROM event
    WHERE type != 'Fundraiser'
)
SELECT nfe.event_name
FROM non_fundraiser_events nfe
JOIN high_attendance_events hae ON nfe.event_id = hae.event_id;

WITH meetings_2020 AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name
    FROM event
    WHERE type = 'Meeting'
      AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2020'
),
total_attendance AS (
    SELECT COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN meetings_2020 m ON a.link_to_event = m.event_id
),
num_meetings AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT event_name) AS num_event_names
    FROM meetings_2020
)
SELECT ta.attendance_count * 1.0 / nm.num_event_names AS average_attendance
FROM total_attendance ta
CROSS JOIN num_meetings nm;

WITH laugh_outloud_event AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud'
),
attendees AS (
    SELECT a.link_to_member
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN laugh_outloud_event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
)
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendees att ON m.member_id = att.link_to_member;

WITH september_meeting AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'September Meeting'
),
food_budget AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id, b.spent
    FROM budget b
    JOIN september_meeting sm ON b.link_to_event = sm.event_id
    WHERE b.category = 'Food'
)
SELECT spent
FROM food_budget;

WITH president AS (
    SELECT member_id, zip
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'President'
)
SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM zip_code AS z
JOIN president AS p ON z.zip_code = p.zip;

WITH fundraising AS (
    SELECT income_id, date_received, link_to_member
    FROM income
    WHERE source = 'Fundraising'
),
fundraising_on_date AS (
    SELECT f.income_id
    FROM fundraising f
    WHERE f.date_received = '2019-09-14'
)
SELECT i.notes
FROM income i
JOIN fundraising_on_date d ON i.income_id = d.income_id;

WITH member_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM member
    WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'
),
target_member AS (
    SELECT member_id
    FROM member
    WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'
)
SELECT phone
FROM member
WHERE member_id = (SELECT member_id FROM target_member LIMIT 1)
  AND (SELECT cnt FROM member_count) > 0;

WITH november_meeting AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'November Meeting'
),
meeting_budgets AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id, b.category, b.spent, b.remaining, b.amount
    FROM budget b
    JOIN november_meeting e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
exceeded_budgets AS (
    SELECT budget_id
    FROM meeting_budgets
    WHERE remaining < 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS exceeded_budget_count
FROM exceeded_budgets;

WITH september_speaker_event AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'September Speaker'
),
event_budgets AS (
    SELECT budget_id, amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM september_speaker_event)
)
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM event_budgets;

WITH business_major AS (
    SELECT major_id
    FROM major
    WHERE major_name = 'Business'
),
business_members AS (
    SELECT member_id, first_name, last_name, t_shirt_size
    FROM member
    WHERE link_to_major = (SELECT major_id FROM business_major)
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM business_members
WHERE t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

WITH dues_income AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM income
    WHERE source = 'Dues'
),
min_dues_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(date_received) AS min_date
    FROM dues_income
),
first_payer AS (
    SELECT link_to_member
    FROM dues_income
    WHERE date_received = (SELECT min_date FROM min_dues_date)
)
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN first_payer fp
    ON m.member_id = fp.link_to_member;

WITH november_speaker AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'November Speaker'
),
parking_budget AS (
    SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS parking_amount
    FROM budget b
    JOIN november_speaker ns ON b.link_to_event = ns.event_id
    WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
),
total_budget AS (
    SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM budget b
    JOIN november_speaker ns ON b.link_to_event = ns.event_id
)
SELECT pb.parking_amount * 100.0 / tb.total_amount AS percentage
FROM parking_budget pb
CROSS JOIN total_budget tb;

WITH pizza_expenses AS (
    SELECT expense_id, cost
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'
),
pizza_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_pizza_expenses
    FROM pizza_expenses
)
SELECT SUM(pe.cost) AS total_pizza_cost
FROM pizza_expenses pe;

WITH amy_zip AS (
    SELECT zip
    FROM member
    WHERE first_name = 'Amy' AND last_name = 'Firth'
),
hometown AS (
    SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
    FROM amy_zip a
    JOIN zip_code z ON a.zip = z.zip_code
)
SELECT city, county, state
FROM hometown;

WITH member_zips AS (
    SELECT zip
    FROM member
),
member_states AS (
    SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name, zip_code.state
    FROM member
    JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
),
maryland_members AS (
    SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
    FROM member m
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    WHERE z.state = 'Maryland'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS maryland_hometown_count
FROM maryland_members;

WITH kickoff_event AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
),
kickoff_budget AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id
    FROM budget b
    JOIN kickoff_event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
budget_manager AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ex.link_to_member
    FROM expense ex
    JOIN kickoff_budget kb ON ex.link_to_budget = kb.budget_id
)
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN budget_manager bm ON m.member_id = bm.link_to_member;

WITH finance_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM member
    JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
    WHERE major.major_name = 'Finance'
),
physics_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM member
    JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
    WHERE major.major_name = 'Physics'
)
SELECT f.cnt * 1.0 / p.cnt AS ratio
FROM finance_count f
CROSS JOIN physics_count p;

WITH secretary AS (
    SELECT member_id, first_name, last_name, email
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Secretary'
)
SELECT first_name, last_name, email
FROM secretary;

WITH total_events AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
),
community_service_events AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cs_count
    FROM event
    WHERE type = 'Community Service'
      AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2019'
)
SELECT cs.cs_count * 100.0 / te.total_count AS percentage
FROM community_service_events cs
CROSS JOIN total_events te;

WITH size_counts AS (
    SELECT t_shirt_size, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY t_shirt_size
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(member_count) AS max_members
    FROM size_counts
)
SELECT sc.t_shirt_size
FROM size_counts sc
JOIN max_count mc ON sc.member_count = mc.max_members;

WITH closed_events AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name
    FROM event
    WHERE status = 'Closed'
),
closed_event_budgets AS (
    SELECT ce.event_name, b.remaining
    FROM closed_events ce
    JOIN budget b ON ce.event_id = b.link_to_event
),
over_budget_events AS (
    SELECT event_name, remaining
    FROM closed_event_budgets
    WHERE remaining < 0
)
SELECT event_name
FROM over_budget_events
ORDER BY remaining ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH target_event AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'April Speaker'
),
event_budget AS (
    SELECT b.category, b.amount
    FROM budget b
    JOIN target_event te ON b.link_to_event = te.event_id
),
total_budgeted AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS amount_budgeted
    FROM event_budget
)
SELECT tb.amount_budgeted, eb.category
FROM event_budget eb
CROSS JOIN total_budgeted tb
ORDER BY eb.amount ASC;

WITH food_budgets AS (
    SELECT budget_id, amount, link_to_event
    FROM budget
    WHERE category = 'Food'
),
max_food_amount AS (
    SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_amount
    FROM food_budgets
)
SELECT fb.budget_id, fb.amount, e.event_name
FROM food_budgets fb
JOIN max_food_amount mf ON fb.amount = mf.max_amount
JOIN event e ON fb.link_to_event = e.event_id;

WITH parking_expenses AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_description = 'Parking'
),
parking_costs AS (
    SELECT cost
    FROM parking_expenses
)
SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM parking_costs;

WITH filtered_expense AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'
),
expense_costs AS (
    SELECT cost
    FROM filtered_expense
)
SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_expense
FROM expense_costs;

WITH phillip AS (
    SELECT member_id, link_to_major
    FROM member
    WHERE first_name = 'Phillip' AND last_name = 'Cullen'
),
phillip_major AS (
    SELECT link_to_major
    FROM phillip
)
SELECT major.major_name
FROM phillip_major pm
JOIN major ON pm.link_to_major = major.major_id;

WITH business_major AS (
    SELECT major_id
    FROM major
    WHERE major_name = 'Business'
),
business_members AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, m.position
    FROM member m
    JOIN business_major bm ON m.link_to_major = bm.major_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT position
FROM business_members;

WITH business_major AS (
    SELECT major_id
    FROM major
    WHERE major_name = 'Business'
),
business_members AS (
    SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.t_shirt_size
    FROM member AS T1
    JOIN business_major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM business_members
WHERE t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

WITH event_on_date AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date = '2020-03-24T12:00:00'
)
SELECT e.type
FROM event e
JOIN event_on_date ed ON e.event_id = ed.event_id;

WITH vice_president AS (
    SELECT member_id, link_to_major
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Vice President'
)
SELECT major.major_name
FROM major
JOIN vice_president ON major.major_id = vice_president.link_to_major;

WITH incomes_50 AS (
    SELECT income_id, date_received, link_to_member
    FROM income
    WHERE amount = 50
),
members_50 AS (
    SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
    FROM member AS m
    JOIN incomes_50 AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS income_count
FROM incomes_50;

WITH college_majors AS (
    SELECT major_name, department
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
),
department_majors AS (
    SELECT major_name
    FROM college_majors
    WHERE department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS major_count
FROM department_majors;

WITH target_majors AS (
    SELECT major_id
    FROM major
    WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
),
member_zips AS (
    SELECT m.zip
    FROM member m
    WHERE m.position = 'Member'
      AND m.link_to_major IN (SELECT major_id FROM target_majors)
)
SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.state
FROM zip_code z
JOIN member_zips mz ON z.zip_code = mz.zip;

WITH soccer_event AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
),
attendees AS (
    SELECT a.link_to_member
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN soccer_event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
club_members AS (
    SELECT member_id, first_name, last_name
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Member'
)
SELECT DISTINCT cm.last_name
FROM club_members cm
JOIN attendees att ON cm.member_id = att.link_to_member;

WITH game_events AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name
    FROM event
    WHERE type = 'Game'
),
closed_events AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name
    FROM event
    WHERE status = 'Closed'
),
dated_events AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'
)
SELECT g.event_name
FROM game_events g
JOIN closed_events c ON g.event_id = c.event_id
JOIN dated_events d ON g.event_id = d.event_id;

WITH approved_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
    FROM member m
    JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
    WHERE e.approved = 'true'
      AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19'
),
attended_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.link_to_member, ev.event_id, ev.event_name
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN event ev ON ev.event_id = a.link_to_event
)
SELECT am.first_name, am.last_name, ae.event_id, ae.event_name
FROM approved_members am
JOIN attended_events ae ON am.member_id = ae.link_to_member;

WITH cost_gt_20 AS (
    SELECT cost, expense_date, link_to_member
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 20
),
in_date_range AS (
    SELECT expense_id
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
),
qualifying_expenses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.link_to_member
    FROM expense e
    JOIN cost_gt_20 c
        ON e.link_to_member = c.link_to_member
       AND e.cost = c.cost
       AND e.expense_date = c.expense_date
    JOIN in_date_range d
        ON e.expense_id = d.expense_id
    WHERE e.cost > 20
      AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
),
member_emails AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T1.email
    FROM member AS T1
    JOIN qualifying_expenses AS T2
        ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
)
SELECT DISTINCT email
FROM member_emails;

WITH education_major AS (
    SELECT major_id
    FROM major
    WHERE major_name = 'education'
      AND college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
),
education_members AS (
    SELECT m.member_id
    FROM member m
    JOIN education_major em
        ON m.link_to_major = em.major_id
    WHERE m.position = 'Member'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
FROM education_members;

WITH total_cost AS (
    SELECT expense_description, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
    FROM expense
    GROUP BY expense_description
),
expense_count AS (
    SELECT expense_description, COUNT(expense_id) AS expense_count
    FROM expense
    GROUP BY expense_description
)
SELECT t.expense_description
FROM total_cost t
JOIN expense_count c
    ON t.expense_description = c.expense_description
WHERE t.total_cost / c.expense_count > 50;

WITH non_member_students AS (
    SELECT member_id, position
    FROM member
    WHERE position != 'Member'
),
total_cost AS (
    SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
    FROM expense e
    JOIN non_member_students m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
),
event_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) AS event_count
    FROM expense e
    JOIN non_member_students m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
)
SELECT tc.total_cost / ec.event_count AS average_amount_paid
FROM total_cost tc
CROSS JOIN event_count ec;

WITH member_spending AS (
    SELECT
        m.member_id,
        m.first_name,
        m.last_name,
        SUM(e.cost) AS total_spending
    FROM member m
    JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
    GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
)
SELECT first_name, last_name
FROM member_spending
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH avg_expense_cost AS (
    SELECT AVG(cost) AS avg_cost
    FROM expense
),
high_spending_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
    FROM member m
    JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
    CROSS JOIN avg_expense_cost a
    WHERE e.cost > a.avg_cost
)
SELECT first_name, last_name, phone
FROM high_spending_members;

WITH garrett_member AS (
    SELECT member_id, link_to_major
    FROM member
    WHERE first_name = 'Garrett' AND last_name = 'Gerke'
),
major_info AS (
    SELECT mj.major_name, mj.department
    FROM major mj
    JOIN garrett_member gm ON mj.major_id = gm.link_to_major
)
SELECT major_name, department
FROM major_info;

WITH elementary_edu_major AS (
    SELECT major_id
    FROM major
    WHERE major_name = 'Elementary Education'
),
attending_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member
    FROM attendance
),
elementary_edu_students AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, m.last_name, m.phone
    FROM member m
    JOIN elementary_edu_major em ON m.link_to_major = em.major_id
    WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM attending_members)
)
SELECT last_name, phone
FROM elementary_edu_students;

WITH secretary AS (
    SELECT first_name, last_name, link_to_major
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Secretary'
),
secretary_major AS (
    SELECT major_id, major_name, college
    FROM major
    WHERE major_id = (SELECT link_to_major FROM secretary)
)
SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, m.college
FROM secretary s
JOIN secretary_major m ON m.major_id = s.link_to_major;

WITH speaker_gifts AS (
    SELECT b.spent, e.event_name
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
)
SELECT SUM(spent) AS total_spent, event_name
FROM speaker_gifts
GROUP BY event_name;

WITH garrett_member AS (
    SELECT member_id, zip
    FROM member
    WHERE first_name = 'Garrett' AND last_name = 'Gerke'
)
SELECT z.city
FROM garrett_member g
JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = g.zip;

WITH hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.superhero_name, s.full_name, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
    GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name, s.full_name
),
powerful_heroes AS (
    SELECT full_name
    FROM hero_power_counts
    WHERE power_count > 15
)
SELECT full_name
FROM powerful_heroes;

WITH blue_colour AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM colour
    WHERE colour = 'Blue'
),
blue_eye_superheroes AS (
    SELECT s.superhero_name
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN blue_colour bc ON s.eye_colour_id = bc.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM blue_eye_superheroes;

WITH marvel_publisher AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM publisher
    WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
),
marvel_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.superhero_name, s.height_cm
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN marvel_publisher mp ON s.publisher_id = mp.id
)
SELECT superhero_name
FROM marvel_heroes
ORDER BY height_cm DESC;

WITH dc_publisher AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM publisher
    WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
),
dc_superheroes AS (
    SELECT s.id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN dc_publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM dc_superheroes;

WITH intelligence_attribute AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM attribute
    WHERE attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
),
min_intelligence AS (
    SELECT MIN(ha.attribute_value) AS min_attribute_value
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    JOIN intelligence_attribute ia ON ha.attribute_id = ia.id
),
dumbest_hero AS (
    SELECT ha.hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    JOIN intelligence_attribute ia ON ha.attribute_id = ia.id
    CROSS JOIN min_intelligence mi
    WHERE ha.attribute_value = mi.min_attribute_value
    ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
WHERE s.id = (SELECT hero_id FROM dumbest_hero);

WITH total_heroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM superhero
),
bad_heroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT b.bad_count * 100.0 / t.total_count AS bad_percentage
    FROM total_heroes t
    CROSS JOIN bad_heroes b
),
marvel_bad AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS marvel_bad_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
      AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
)
SELECT p.bad_percentage, m.marvel_bad_count
FROM percentage p
CROSS JOIN marvel_bad m;

WITH star_trek_publisher AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM publisher
    WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek'
)
SELECT id AS publisher_id
FROM star_trek_publisher;

WITH superheroes_without_full_name AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_superheroes_without_full_name
FROM superheroes_without_full_name;

WITH hero_exists AS (
    SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM superhero WHERE id = 75) AS exists_flag
),
hero_eye_colour_id AS (
    SELECT eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE id = 75
)
SELECT c.colour
FROM colour c
JOIN hero_eye_colour_id h ON c.id = h.eye_colour_id
CROSS JOIN hero_exists e
WHERE e.exists_flag;

WITH female_gender AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM gender
    WHERE gender = 'Female'
),
female_superheroes AS (
    SELECT s.superhero_name, s.weight_kg
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN female_gender fg ON s.gender_id = fg.id
),
female_weights AS (
    SELECT weight_kg
    FROM female_superheroes
)
SELECT AVG(weight_kg)
FROM female_weights;

WITH alien_race AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM race
    WHERE race = 'Alien'
),
alien_superheroes AS (
    SELECT superhero_name
    FROM superhero
    WHERE race_id IN (SELECT id FROM alien_race)
)
SELECT superhero_name
FROM alien_superheroes;

WITH no_colour AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM colour
    WHERE colour = 'No Colour'
),
target_superheroes AS (
    SELECT superhero_name, eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
)
SELECT t.superhero_name
FROM target_superheroes t
JOIN no_colour n ON t.eye_colour_id = n.id;

WITH demi_god_race AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM race
    WHERE race = 'Demi-God'
),
demi_god_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.full_name
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN demi_god_race r ON s.race_id = r.id
)
SELECT full_name
FROM demi_god_heroes
LIMIT 5;

WITH human_race AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM race
    WHERE race = 'Human'
),
target_hero AS (
    SELECT hair_colour_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm = 185
      AND race_id = (SELECT id FROM human_race)
)
SELECT colour.colour
FROM colour
JOIN target_hero ON colour.id = target_hero.hair_colour_id;

WITH hero AS (
    SELECT superhero_name
    FROM superhero
    WHERE id = 1
),
powers AS (
    SELECT power_id
    FROM hero_power
    WHERE hero_id = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superpower sp
JOIN powers p ON sp.id = p.power_id;

WITH strength_attr AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM attribute
    WHERE attribute_name = 'strength'
),
max_strength AS (
    SELECT MAX(ha.attribute_value) AS max_val
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    JOIN strength_attr sa ON ha.attribute_id = sa.id
),
top_hero AS (
    SELECT ha.hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    JOIN strength_attr sa ON ha.attribute_id = sa.id
    WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT max_val FROM max_strength)
)
SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN top_hero th ON s.id = th.hero_id;

WITH no_skin_colour AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM colour
    WHERE id = 1
),
total_superheroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(id) AS total_count
    FROM superhero
),
no_skin_colour_superheroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_skin_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN no_skin_colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
)
SELECT t.total_count / n.no_skin_count AS average
FROM total_superheroes AS t
CROSS JOIN no_skin_colour_superheroes AS n;

WITH charles_chandler AS (
    SELECT id, superhero_name, race_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
)
SELECT c.superhero_name, r.race
FROM charles_chandler c
JOIN race r ON r.id = c.race_id;

WITH amber_colour AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM colour
    WHERE colour = 'Amber'
),
amber_eye_heroes AS (
    SELECT superhero_name, height_cm
    FROM superhero
    WHERE eye_colour_id IN (SELECT id FROM amber_colour)
)
SELECT height_cm
FROM amber_eye_heroes;

WITH gold_colour AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM colour
    WHERE colour = 'Gold'
),
gold_skin_heroes AS (
    SELECT superhero_name, eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE skin_colour_id = (SELECT id FROM gold_colour)
),
gold_skin_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT s.eye_colour_id
    FROM gold_skin_heroes s
),
eye_colour_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
    FROM gold_skin_eye_colours g
    JOIN colour c ON g.eye_colour_id = c.id
)
SELECT colour
FROM eye_colour_names;

WITH vampire_race AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM race
    WHERE race = 'Vampire'
),
vampire_heroes AS (
    SELECT superhero.full_name
    FROM superhero
    JOIN vampire_race ON superhero.race_id = vampire_race.id
)
SELECT full_name
FROM vampire_heroes;

WITH female_marvel AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_heroes
    FROM superhero
    JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
    JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
    WHERE gender.gender = 'Female'
      AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
),
total_marvel AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_heroes
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
)
SELECT (fm.female_heroes * 100.0) / tm.total_heroes AS percentage
FROM female_marvel fm
CROSS JOIN total_marvel tm;

WITH emil_weight AS (
    SELECT SUM(weight_kg) AS weight_kg
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky'
),
charles_weight AS (
    SELECT SUM(weight_kg) AS weight_kg
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
)
SELECT emil_weight.weight_kg - charles_weight.weight_kg AS weight_difference
FROM emil_weight
CROSS JOIN charles_weight;

WITH hero_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_heroes
    FROM superhero
),
total_height AS (
    SELECT SUM(height_cm) AS sum_height
    FROM superhero
)
SELECT th.sum_height / hc.total_heroes AS average_height
FROM total_height th
CROSS JOIN hero_count hc;

WITH all_publishers AS (
    SELECT id, publisher_name
    FROM publisher
),
no_publisher AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM all_publishers
    WHERE id = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id IN (SELECT id FROM no_publisher);

WITH hero_id AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'
),
hero_eye_colour AS (
    SELECT s.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN hero_id h ON s.id = h.id
)
SELECT c.colour
FROM colour c
JOIN hero_eye_colour e ON c.id = e.eye_colour_id;

WITH hero AS (
    SELECT superhero_name, publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE id = 38
)
SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM publisher p
JOIN hero h ON p.id = h.publisher_id;

WITH atom_id AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Atom IV'
),
atom_alignment AS (
    SELECT superhero.id, alignment.alignment
    FROM superhero
    JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
    WHERE superhero.id IN (SELECT id FROM atom_id)
),
atom_powers AS (
    SELECT hero_power.hero_id, superpower.power_name
    FROM hero_power
    JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
    WHERE hero_power.hero_id IN (SELECT id FROM atom_id)
)
SELECT atom_alignment.alignment, atom_powers.power_name
FROM atom_alignment
JOIN atom_powers ON atom_powers.hero_id = atom_alignment.id;

WITH attr_75_80 AS (
    SELECT hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute
    WHERE attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80
),
attr_above_100 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute
    WHERE attribute_value > 100
),
hero_names AS (
    SELECT id, superhero_name
    FROM superhero
)
SELECT DISTINCT h.superhero_name
FROM hero_names h
JOIN attr_75_80 a ON h.id = a.hero_id
WHERE h.id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM attr_above_100);

WITH blue_colour AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM colour
    WHERE colour = 'blue'
),
male_gender AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM gender
    WHERE gender = 'male'
),
blue_haired_male_superhero AS (
    SELECT superhero.id, superhero.superhero_name, superhero.race_id
    FROM superhero
    JOIN blue_colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = blue_colour.id
    JOIN male_gender ON superhero.gender_id = male_gender.id
)
SELECT race.race
FROM blue_haired_male_superhero
JOIN race ON blue_haired_male_superhero.race_id = race.id;

WITH bad_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_bad
    FROM superhero
    WHERE alignment_id = 2
),
bad_female_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_bad_female
    FROM superhero
    WHERE alignment_id = 2 AND gender_id = 2
)
SELECT (bf.total_bad_female * 100.0) / bc.total_bad AS percentage
FROM bad_count bc
CROSS JOIN bad_female_count bf;

WITH hulk AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Hulk'
),
strength_attribute AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM attribute
    WHERE attribute_name = 'Strength'
)
SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN hulk ON ha.hero_id = hulk.id
JOIN strength_attribute sa ON ha.attribute_id = sa.id;

WITH green_colour AS (
    SELECT id 
    FROM colour 
    WHERE colour = 'Green'
),
bad_alignment AS (
    SELECT id 
    FROM alignment 
    WHERE alignment = 'Bad'
),
green_skinned_superheroes AS (
    SELECT superhero_name
    FROM superhero
    WHERE skin_colour_id = (SELECT id FROM green_colour)
),
green_skinned_villains AS (
    SELECT superhero_name
    FROM green_skinned_superheroes
    WHERE superhero_name IN (
        SELECT superhero_name 
        FROM superhero 
        WHERE skin_colour_id = (SELECT id FROM green_colour)
          AND alignment_id = (SELECT id FROM bad_alignment)
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_green_skinned_villains
FROM green_skinned_villains;

WITH dark_horse_publisher AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM publisher
    WHERE publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
),
non_human_race AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM race
    WHERE race <> 'Human'
),
non_human_dark_horse_heroes AS (
    SELECT superhero_name, height_cm
    FROM superhero
    WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM dark_horse_publisher)
      AND race_id IN (SELECT id FROM non_human_race)
)
SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS average_height
FROM non_human_dark_horse_heroes;

WITH speed_attribute AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM attribute
    WHERE attribute_name = 'Speed'
),
fast_heroes AS (
    SELECT hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute
    JOIN speed_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = speed_attribute.id
    WHERE hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) AS fastest_superhero_count
FROM fast_heroes;

WITH hero_id AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
)
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_id h ON s.id = h.id;

WITH min_value AS (
    SELECT MIN(attribute_value) AS min_attribute_value
    FROM hero_attribute
)
SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute
WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT min_attribute_value FROM min_value);

WITH alien_id AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'
)
SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alien_id a ON s.id = a.id;

WITH brown_colour AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM colour
    WHERE colour = 'brown'
),
light_weight_heroes AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE weight_kg < 100
),
brown_eye_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN brown_colour bc ON s.eye_colour_id = bc.id
)
SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN light_weight_heroes lw ON s.id = lw.id
JOIN brown_eye_heroes be ON s.id = be.id;

WITH hero_info AS (
    SELECT weight_kg, race_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE id = 40
)
SELECT hi.weight_kg, r.race
FROM hero_info hi
JOIN race r ON r.id = hi.race_id;

WITH neutral_alignment AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM alignment
    WHERE alignment = 'Neutral'
),
neutral_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.height_cm
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN neutral_alignment na ON s.alignment_id = na.id
)
SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS average_height
FROM neutral_heroes;

WITH intelligence_power AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superpower
    WHERE power_name = 'Intelligence'
),
intelligent_heroes AS (
    SELECT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN intelligence_power ip ON hp.power_id = ip.id
)
SELECT s.id AS hero_id
FROM superhero s
WHERE s.id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM intelligent_heroes);

WITH avg_height AS (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS avg_height_cm
    FROM superhero
),
tall_superheroes AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.superhero_name
    FROM superhero s
    CROSS JOIN avg_height a
    WHERE s.height_cm > a.avg_height_cm * 0.8
)
SELECT p.power_name
FROM tall_superheroes t
JOIN hero_power hp ON t.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id;

WITH inpatient_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+'
),
outpatient_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-'
),
more_group AS (
    SELECT CASE
             WHEN i.cnt > o.cnt THEN 'male in-patients'
             ELSE 'male outpatients'
           END AS more_common
    FROM inpatient_count i, outpatient_count o
),
deviation AS (
    SELECT CAST(i.cnt AS REAL) / o.cnt AS deviation_percentage
    FROM inpatient_count i, outpatient_count o
)
SELECT m.more_common, d.deviation_percentage
FROM more_group m, deviation d;

WITH TotalPatients AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
),
InpatientCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS inpatient_count
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
      AND Admission = '+'
)
SELECT CAST(InpatientCount.inpatient_count AS REAL) * 100 / TotalPatients.total_count AS percentage
FROM InpatientCount
CROSS JOIN TotalPatients;

WITH PositiveCoagulation AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE RVVT = '+'
),
PatientBirthday AS (
    SELECT P.ID, P.Birthday
    FROM Patient AS P
    JOIN PositiveCoagulation AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
)
SELECT ID,
       YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(Birthday) AS age
FROM PatientBirthday;

WITH SevereThrombosis AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis = 2
)
SELECT ID, SEX, Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM SevereThrombosis);

WITH LowALB AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB < 3.5
),
PatientDiagnosis AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
    FROM Patient AS T1
    JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
)
SELECT D.ID, D.SEX, D.Diagnosis
FROM PatientDiagnosis D
JOIN LowALB L ON D.ID = L.ID;

WITH NormalTG AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
),
EligiblePatients AS (
    SELECT P.ID, P.Birthday
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN NormalTG N ON P.ID = N.ID
),
BirthYears AS (
    SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year
    FROM EligiblePatients
)
SELECT MAX(birth_year) - MIN(birth_year) AS age_gap
FROM BirthYears;

WITH OldestSJS AS (
    SELECT ID, Birthday, "First Date"
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS'
    ORDER BY Birthday ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
LabDate AS (
    SELECT L.Date
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    JOIN OldestSJS AS O ON L.ID = O.ID
    LIMIT 1
),
ArrivalYear AS (
    SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', "First Date") AS INTEGER) AS ArrivalYear
    FROM OldestSJS
),
BirthYear AS (
    SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS BirthYear
    FROM OldestSJS
)
SELECT LD.Date AS "Laboratory Date",
       A.ArrivalYear - B.BirthYear AS "Age at First Arrival"
FROM LabDate AS LD
CROSS JOIN ArrivalYear AS A
CROSS JOIN BirthYear AS B;

WITH male_abnormal_ua AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS male_count
    FROM Patient
    JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
    WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.UA <= 8.0
),
female_abnormal_ua AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS female_count
    FROM Patient
    JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
    WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.UA <= 6.5
)
SELECT CAST(m.male_count AS REAL) / f.female_count AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM male_abnormal_ua AS m
CROSS JOIN female_abnormal_ua AS f;

WITH LabIDs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
),
PatientAges AS (
    SELECT ID,
           1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
    FROM Patient
)
SELECT AVG(PatientAges.Age) AS Average_Age
FROM PatientAges
JOIN LabIDs ON PatientAges.ID = LabIDs.ID;

WITH target_patient AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
      AND Description = '1994-02-19'
),
exam_on_date AS (
    SELECT ID, `aCL IgM`
    FROM Examination
    WHERE `Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
)
SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM target_patient P
JOIN exam_on_date E ON P.ID = E.ID;

WITH gpt_9_ids AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT = '9'
      AND Date = '1992-06-12'
)
SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM gpt_9_ids);

WITH target_patient AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE UA = '8.4' AND Date = '1991-10-21'
),
patient_birthday AS (
    SELECT p.Birthday
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN target_patient t ON p.ID = t.ID
)
SELECT SUBTRACT(year('1991-10-21'), year(patient_birthday.Birthday)) AS age
FROM patient_birthday;

WITH cte_sle AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE `Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
      AND Diagnosis = 'SLE'
),
cte_first_visit AS (
    SELECT ID, `First Date`, Diagnosis
    FROM Patient
)
SELECT fv.Diagnosis AS original_diagnosis
FROM cte_first_visit fv
JOIN cte_sle sle ON fv.ID = sle.ID;

WITH female_patients AS (
    SELECT ID, Birthday, Admission
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
),
female_born_1964 AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM female_patients
    WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
),
female_born_1964_admitted AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM female_patients
    WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
      AND Admission = '+'
)
SELECT ID
FROM female_born_1964_admitted
ORDER BY ID;

WITH threshold AS (
    -- Sub-question 2: threshold defined as the average aCL IgM across all examinations, 20% higher
    SELECT AVG("aCL IgM") * 1.2 AS thr
    FROM Examination
),
target_patients AS (
    -- Sub-question 3: distinct patient IDs with Thrombosis = 2 and ANA = 'S'
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis = 2
      AND ANA = 'S'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS distinct_patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN target_patients p ON e.ID = p.ID
CROSS JOIN threshold t
WHERE e."aCL IgM" > t.thr;

WITH exam_pss AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'PSS'
),
lab_criteria AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CRP > 2
      AND CRE = 1
      AND LDH = 123
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN exam_pss e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN lab_criteria l ON p.ID = l.ID;

WITH sle_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
),
sle_symptoms AS (
    SELECT E.Symptoms
    FROM sle_patients AS P
    JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
)
SELECT Symptoms
FROM sle_symptoms
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH patient_info AS (
    SELECT Description, SEX, Diagnosis
    FROM Patient
    WHERE ID = 48473
)
SELECT Description, Diagnosis
FROM patient_info
WHERE SEX = 'F';

WITH ra_1980_patients AS (
    SELECT SEX
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA'
      AND YEAR(Birthday) = '1980'
),
total_patients AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM ra_1980_patients
),
female_patients AS (
    SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count
    FROM ra_1980_patients
)
SELECT (fp.female_count * 100.0) / tp.total_count AS percentage_of_women
FROM total_patients tp
CROSS JOIN female_patients fp;

WITH testing_1995_1997 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
),
behcet_diagnosed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
),
male_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
),
male_no_admission AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-'
),
qualified_patients AS (
    SELECT t.ID
    FROM testing_1995_1997 t
    INNER JOIN behcet_diagnosed b ON t.ID = b.ID
    INNER JOIN male_patients m ON t.ID = m.ID
    INNER JOIN male_no_admission na ON t.ID = na.ID
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM qualified_patients;

WITH FirstVisit AS (
    SELECT "First Date"
    FROM Patient
    WHERE ID = 821298
),
FirstExam AS (
    SELECT MIN("Examination Date") AS "Examination Date"
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ID = 821298
)
SELECT JULIANDAY(FE."Examination Date") - JULIANDAY(FV."First Date") AS DaysToEvaluation
FROM FirstVisit FV
CROSS JOIN FirstExam FE;

WITH all_ldh AS (
    SELECT LDH
    FROM Laboratory
),
normal_range AS (
    SELECT LDH
    FROM all_ldh
    WHERE LDH < 500
)
SELECT AVG(LDH) AS average_ldh
FROM normal_range;

WITH target_patient AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday = '1982-04-01'
),
patient_lab AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.ALP, l.Date
    FROM Laboratory l
    INNER JOIN target_patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
latest_lab AS (
    SELECT ID, ALP
    FROM patient_lab
    ORDER BY Date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ID,
       CASE WHEN ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM latest_lab;

WITH female_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
),
female_tp AS (
    SELECT L.TP
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN female_patients F ON L.ID = F.ID
    WHERE L.TP > 8.5
)
SELECT TP, TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM female_tp;

WITH male_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
),
abnormal_albumin AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB <= 3.5 OR ALB >= 5.5
)
SELECT p.*
FROM Patient p
JOIN male_patients m ON p.ID = m.ID
JOIN abnormal_albumin a ON p.ID = a.ID
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC;

WITH PatientsBorn1982 AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1982'
),
LabAlbumin AS (
    SELECT ID, ALB
    FROM Laboratory
),
AlbuminStatus AS (
    SELECT ID,
           ALB,
           CASE
               WHEN ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
               ELSE 'Outside normal range'
           END AS AlbuminStatus
    FROM LabAlbumin
)
SELECT p.ID,
       a.ALB,
       a.AlbuminStatus
FROM PatientsBorn1982 p
JOIN AlbuminStatus a ON p.ID = a.ID;

WITH latest_labs AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
latest_ua AS (
    SELECT L.ID, P.SEX, L.UA
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID
    JOIN latest_labs LL
        ON LL.ID = L.ID AND LL.latest_date = L.Date
),
normal_ua AS (
    SELECT UA
    FROM latest_ua
    WHERE (SEX = 'M' AND UA < 8.0)
       OR (SEX = 'F' AND UA < 6.5)
)
SELECT AVG(UA) AS average_ua_index
FROM normal_ua;

WITH ra_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA'
),
un_normal_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE UN < 30
)
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM ra_patients)
  AND P.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM un_normal_patients);

WITH AbnormalCRE AS (
    SELECT ID, CRE
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CRE >= 1.5
),
MaleCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS male_count
    FROM Patient AS T1
    JOIN AbnormalCRE AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
    WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
),
FemaleCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS female_count
    FROM Patient
    JOIN AbnormalCRE ON Patient.ID = AbnormalCRE.ID
    WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
)
SELECT (SELECT male_count FROM MaleCount) > (SELECT female_count FROM FemaleCount);

WITH abnormal_bil AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `T-BIL` >= 2.0
),
filtered_patients AS (
    SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX
    FROM Patient AS T1
    JOIN abnormal_bil AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
)
SELECT SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM filtered_patients
GROUP BY SEX;

WITH MaxTCHO AS (
    SELECT MAX("T-CHO") AS max_tcho
    FROM Laboratory
),
HighestTCHOPatients AS (
    SELECT ID, "T-CHO"
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "T-CHO" = (SELECT max_tcho FROM MaxTCHO)
)
SELECT P.ID, H."T-CHO"
FROM HighestTCHOPatients AS H
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = H.ID
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH abnormal_aptt AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE APTT > 45
),
no_thrombosis AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_patients
FROM abnormal_aptt a
JOIN no_thrombosis n ON a.ID = n.ID;

WITH patients_born_after_1980 AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday > '1980-01-01'
),
patient_lab_records AS (
    SELECT Laboratory.ID, Laboratory.FG
    FROM Laboratory
    JOIN patients_born_after_1980 ON Laboratory.ID = patients_born_after_1980.ID
),
abnormal_fg_records AS (
    SELECT ID, FG
    FROM patient_lab_records
    WHERE FG < 150 OR FG > 450
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM abnormal_fg_records;

WITH HighProteinuria AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` >= 30
),
PatientDiagnosis AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Diagnosis
    FROM Patient
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM HighProteinuria)
)
SELECT Diagnosis
FROM PatientDiagnosis;

WITH NormalProteinuria AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` > 0 AND `U-PRO` < 30
),
SLEDiagnosed AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
)
SELECT ID
FROM NormalProteinuria
INTERSECT
SELECT ID
FROM SLEDiagnosed;

WITH distinct_igg AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT IGG
    FROM Laboratory
),
high_igg AS (
    SELECT IGG
    FROM distinct_igg
    WHERE IGG >= 2000
),
high_igg_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN high_igg h ON l.IGG = h.IGG
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS num_patients
FROM high_igg_patients;

WITH normal_igg AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE IGG > 900 AND IGG < 2000
),
patient_symptoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, e.Symptoms
    FROM Patient p
    LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ID) AS num_patients
FROM patient_symptoms ps
JOIN normal_igg n ON ps.ID = n.ID
WHERE ps.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

WITH abnormal_crp AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CRP = '+'
),
no_data_recorded AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Description IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.ID)
FROM abnormal_crp AS A
JOIN no_data_recorded AS B ON A.ID = B.ID;

WITH AbnormalCRE AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CRE >= 1.5
),
PatientAge AS (
    SELECT ID,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
    FROM Patient
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.ID) AS Total
FROM Patient pa
JOIN AbnormalCRE a ON pa.ID = a.ID
JOIN PatientAge p_age ON pa.ID = p_age.ID
WHERE p_age.Age < 70;

WITH NormalRF AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
    FROM Patient AS T1
    JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
    WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
),
PositiveKCT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
    FROM Patient AS T1
    JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
    WHERE T2.KCT = '+'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS NumPatients
FROM NormalRF AS T1
JOIN PositiveKCT AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

WITH NormalRF AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RF < 20
),
OlderThan60 AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday) > 60
)
SELECT ID
FROM NormalRF
INTERSECT
SELECT ID
FROM OlderThan60;

WITH APS_Patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'APS'
),
Lab_C4 AS (
    SELECT L.ID, L.C4
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
),
Normal_C4_Patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Lab_C4
    WHERE C4 > 10
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.ID) AS num_patients
FROM APS_Patients A
JOIN Normal_C4_Patients N ON A.ID = N.ID;

WITH NormalSM AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SM IN ('-', '+-')
),
NoThrombosis AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT N.ID) AS patient_count
FROM NormalSM AS N
JOIN NoThrombosis AS T
    ON N.ID = T.ID;

WITH ExamAfter AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE `Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
),
NormalSC170 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
)
SELECT ID
FROM ExamAfter
INTERSECT
SELECT ID
FROM NormalSC170;

WITH NormalScl70 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
),
NoSymptom AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Symptoms IS NULL
),
Female AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT F.ID) AS num_female_no_symptom
FROM Female F
JOIN NormalScl70 N ON F.ID = N.ID
JOIN NoSymptom S ON F.ID = S.ID;

WITH NormalSSA AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SSA IN ('-', '+-')
),
EarlyVisitors AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE YEAR(`First Date`) < 2000
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS NumPatients
FROM Patient
JOIN NormalSSA ON Patient.ID = NormalSSA.ID
JOIN EarlyVisitors ON Patient.ID = EarlyVisitors.ID;

WITH normal_dna AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE DNA < 8
),
no_description AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Description IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT nd.ID) AS patient_count
FROM normal_dna nd
JOIN no_description ndesc ON nd.ID = ndesc.ID;

WITH abnormal_total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS total_cnt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GOT >= 60
),
abnormal_sle AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS sle_cnt
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
    WHERE L.GOT >= 60
      AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
)
SELECT (sle_cnt * 1.0) / total_cnt AS percentage
FROM abnormal_total, abnormal_sle;

WITH abnormal_GOT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GOT >= 60
),
candidate_birthdays AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T2.Birthday
    FROM Examination AS T1
    JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
    WHERE T1.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM abnormal_GOT)
)
SELECT MAX(Birthday)
FROM candidate_birthdays;

WITH MaxLDH AS (

    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM target_molecules
);

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
),
atom_counts AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN carcinogenic_molecules cm ON a.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
max_atom_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count) AS max_count
    FROM atom_counts
)
SELECT ac.molecule_id
FROM atom_counts ac
JOIN max_atom_count mac ON ac.atom_count = mac.max_count;

WITH oxygen_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'o'
),
molecules_double_bonded_oxygen AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id
    FROM oxygen_atoms oa
    JOIN atom a ON oa.atom_id = a.atom_id
    JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM molecules_double_bonded_oxygen;

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '-'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.molecule_id) AS num_non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules
FROM triple_bond_molecules t
JOIN non_carcinogenic_molecules n
    ON t.molecule_id = n.molecule_id;

WITH max_reputation AS (
    -- The most influential user = the one with the maximum reputation
    SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_rep
    FROM users
),
stats_posts AS (
    -- All posts made by the user(s) whose reputation equals MAX(Reputation)
    SELECT p.Id, p.Score
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
    CROSS JOIN max_reputation mr
    WHERE u.Reputation = mr.max_rep
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Score > 50 THEN Id END) AS REAL) / COUNT(Id) AS percentage
FROM stats_posts;

WITH totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (CZK currency only)
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of lowest-consumption customers
    --                 / number of those customers, per segment
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment
     AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM annual_avg;

SELECT DISTINCT
       a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(d2.A11) FROM district d2) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp     dp ON c.client_id    = dp.client_id
JOIN account  a  ON dp.account_id  = a.account_id
JOIN district d  ON c.district_id  = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female: later birth_date = older person
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(c2.birth_date)
                      FROM client c2
                      WHERE c2.gender = 'F')
  -- among those oldest females, keep the one(s) with the lowest average salary (A11)
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d3.A11)
               FROM client c3
               JOIN district d3 ON c3.district_id = d3.district_id
               WHERE c3.gender = 'F'
                 AND c3.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(c4.birth_date)
                                      FROM client c4
                                      WHERE c4.gender = 'F'));

SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.date         AS loan_date,
    l.amount       AS debt_amount,          -- outstanding (unpaid) loan amount
    l.duration     AS duration_in_months,
    l.payments     AS monthly_payment,      -- regular payment the client makes
    l.status,
    CASE
        WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no payment problems'
        WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 'Contract running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 'Contract running - client currently in debt'
    END            AS payment_performance
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992
  AND l.status IN ('B', 'D');            -- only loans that carry debt

FROM    Patient AS P
