SELECT AVG(T.UA) AS average_UA
FROM (
    SELECT l.ID,
           l.UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory l
) T
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = T.ID
WHERE T.rn = 1
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
    OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT (SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')) AS Answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID,
       L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
  ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (L.FG < 150 OR L.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+'
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND YEAR(Patient.`First Date`) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS `First Date`
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID = (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY L.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT T1.Date
FROM Laboratory AS T1
WHERE T1.ALB > 3.5 AND T1.ALB < 5.5
  AND T1.ALB = (
      SELECT MAX(T2.ALB)
      FROM Laboratory AS T2
      WHERE T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.ALB > 3.5
  AND l.ALB < 5.5
  AND l.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T1."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T1.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecule_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T3.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
       (SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id)
        FROM atom AS T1
        JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
        WHERE T2.label = '+')
FROM bond AS T3
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = '+';

SELECT CAST(SUM(element = 'c') AS REAL) / COUNT(atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
UNION
SELECT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond.bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'not carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2     ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id2 = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2     ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'pb';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS REAL) * 100 / (
    SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.atom_id) AS REAL)
    FROM connected AS T2
             JOIN atom AS A1 ON T2.atom_id = A1.atom_id
             JOIN atom AS A2 ON T2.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
    GROUP BY A1.element, A2.element
    ORDER BY COUNT(T2.atom_id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1;

SELECT 
    CAST(
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(b.bond_id) 
        AS DECIMAL(10, 5)
    ) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
    OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(T1.element) AS toxicology_element_count
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'                        -- '+' marks carcinogenic molecules
  AND substr(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';       -- picks out the 4th atom of each molecule

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT bond.molecule_id
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
            ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b
       ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS chlorine_bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT atom.atom_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM   atom
JOIN   bond
       ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE  atom.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP  BY atom.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE element = 's'
) 
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT A1.molecule_id
FROM connected AS C
JOIN atom AS A1 ON C.atom_id = A1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS A2 ON C.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
WHERE A1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND A2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    label,
    CASE 
        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a      ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '-'
  AND molecule_id IN (
      SELECT molecule_id
      FROM bond
      WHERE bond_type = '#'
  );

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate

SELECT T1.sname

SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT T2.District

SELECT T2.CharterNum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite)

INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

SELECT T2.FundingType, T1.dname

GROUP BY T1.dname

SELECT "Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)" FROM frpm ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(s1.NumTstTakr)

WHERE strftime('%Y', s2.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School

JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

SELECT T2.MailStreet, T1.sname

INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND City = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

SELECT County

LIMIT 1;

SELECT "School Name", "FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Low Grade" = 'K' AND "High Grade" = '9'
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(GSserved) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.City, T1.`Low Grade`, T2.School

WHERE T2.State = 'CA'

SELECT T1.City, COUNT(*)

FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

SELECT DisplayName FROM users ORDER BY Views DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie')

SELECT p.Body

SELECT AVG(p.Score) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount = 1910);

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT p.Segment, SUM(p.total_consumption) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM czk_2013 p
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS difference_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS difference_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS difference_KAM_SME;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
        FROM yearmonth AS y
        JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
    ) AS t
    WHERE t.total_consumption = (
        SELECT MIN(t2.total_consumption)
        FROM (
            SELECT c2.Segment AS Segment, y2.CustomerID, SUM(y2.Consumption) AS total_consumption
            FROM yearmonth AS y2
            JOIN customers AS c2 ON y2.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
            WHERE c2.Currency = 'CZK'
              AND y2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            GROUP BY c2.Segment, y2.CustomerID
        ) AS t2
        WHERE t2.Segment = t.Segment
    )
    GROUP BY Segment
) AS finals;

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc
      ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_total
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT full_name
FROM superhero
WHERE weight_kg < 100
  AND eye_colour_id IN (SELECT id FROM colour WHERE colour = 'Brown');

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT s.id
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superhero.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        THEN 'More in-patients' 
        ELSE 'More outpatients' 
    END AS comparison,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
          SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(Patient.Birthday, 1, 4)) - MIN(SUBSTR(Patient.Birthday, 1, 4))
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Date, YEAR(T2.`First Date`) - YEAR(T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT `Examination`.`aCL IgM`
FROM `Patient`
JOIN `Examination` ON `Patient`.`ID` = `Examination`.`ID`
WHERE `Patient`.`Diagnosis` = 'SLE'
  AND `Patient`.`Description` = '1994-02-19'
  AND `Examination`.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT SUBTRACT(YEAR(T1.Date), YEAR(T2.Birthday))
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'

  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'

  AND T3.LDH = 123;
SELECT MAX(T1.Symptoms) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT T1.Description, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.ID = 48473

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT DATEDIFF(T1.`Examination Date`, T2.`First Date`)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, L.ALB
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)

SELECT p.ID, l.ALB,
       CASE 
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
           ELSE 'Outside normal range'
       END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE YEAR(p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS Average_UA
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) Latest ON L.ID = Latest.ID AND L.Date = Latest.LatestDate
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5);

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS Result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS List
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
  AND P.Birthday = (SELECT MIN(P2.Birthday)

                    WHERE L2."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory));

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient

WHERE Laboratory.IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(P.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.RA IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND YEAR(T1.`First Date`) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
  AND L.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory l

SELECT P.Diagnosis

LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
GROUP BY b.bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(c.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY atom.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T4.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY T1.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top ON m.molecule_id = top.molecule_id;

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND bond.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS elem_counts;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
    OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';

SELECT SUM(b.bond_type = ' = ') / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM bond
     WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006'
       AND bond.bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count,
    (SELECT molecule.label
     FROM molecule
     WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR006') AS carcinogenic;

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT atom.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY atom.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') 
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
JOIN atom a2 ON m.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT

        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

ORDER BY COUNT(a.molecule_id) DESC

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m

SELECT 
    T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)`
FROM 
    frpm AS T1
WHERE 
    T1.`Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
    AND T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY 
    `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

SELECT schools.Phone

SELECT CDSCode

FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT 
    T2.School, 
    T2.Street, 
    T2.City, 
    T2.State, 
    T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
    AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
    AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Annual (2013) consumption per customer who pays in CZK
    SELECT y.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312   -- Year 2013
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS lowest_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of lowest customers / number of such customers
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 AS z
    JOIN lowest_per_segment AS l
      ON z.Segment = l.Segment
     AND z.total_consumption = l.lowest_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T1.overall_rating) / COUNT(T1.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT PA.preferred_foot
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) 
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT T2.player_name 
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
WHERE T1.overall_rating = 77 
  AND T1.date LIKE '2016-06-23%' 
ORDER BY T2.birthday ASC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND T1.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND T2.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) 
FROM Player AS T1 
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' 
    AND substr(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT player_name,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS rank_height
    FROM Player
) AS T1
WHERE T1.rank_height = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Match AS m
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country AS c
    ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name, T4.name AS country
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Match AS T3 ON T1.player_api_id IN (
        T3.home_player_1,  T3.home_player_2,  T3.home_player_3,  T3.home_player_4,
        T3.home_player_5,  T3.home_player_6,  T3.home_player_7,  T3.home_player_8,
        T3.home_player_9,  T3.home_player_10, T3.home_player_11,
        T3.away_player_1,  T3.away_player_2,  T3.away_player_3,  T3.away_player_4,
        T3.away_player_5,  T3.away_player_6,  T3.away_player_7,  T3.away_player_8,
        T3.away_player_9,  T3.away_player_10, T3.away_player_11
    )
INNER JOIN Country AS T4 ON T3.country_id = T4.id
WHERE T2.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name
FROM Country AS C
INNER JOIN Match AS M ON C.id = M.country_id
INNER JOIN Player AS P ON M.home_player_1 = P.player_api_id
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY AVG(P.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT AVG(T2.height) 
FROM Match AS T1 
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id 
INNER JOIN Country AS T3 ON T1.country_id = T3.id 
WHERE T3.name = 'Italy';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN loan ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.district_id)
FROM district AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T2.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.A11 > 6000
  AND T1.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp    ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a  ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date)
                      FROM client
                      WHERE gender = 'F')
ORDER BY d.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND T2.amount = (
        SELECT MAX(amount)
        FROM loan
        WHERE duration > 12
      )
  AND T1.date LIKE '1993%';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(trans.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM trans
JOIN disp ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_approved_loans
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status = 'C';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE account.district_id = 1 
  AND loan.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE card.type = 'gold' 
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trans.account_id)
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND trans.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha' 
  AND client.gender = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.client_id = 3541

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_female
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
WHERE d.A11 > 10000;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', loan.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', loan.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END))
       * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', loan.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN loan.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', loan.date) AS INTEGER) IN (1996, 1997);
SELECT (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') - (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia')

SELECT strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE disp.account_id = 130
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT T2.amount, T2.payments, T2.status
FROM disp AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.client_id = 992

SELECT SUM(trans.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans
JOIN disp ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 617
  AND trans.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND trans.date < '1999-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun' 
  AND account.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(loan_id)
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.duration = 24
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT c.client_id,
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM card AS cd
JOIN disp AS d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(T1.link_to_member) 
FROM attendance AS T1 
JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id 
WHERE T2.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_event) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T3.event_id) AS num_events
FROM member AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND T1.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3.event_date) = '2019';

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id)
FROM event AS T1
WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting'
  AND T1.event_id IN (
      SELECT T2.link_to_event
      FROM attendance AS T2
      GROUP BY T2.link_to_event
      HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_member) > 10
  );

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(e.event_id) > 20;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.event_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.event_date) = '2020'

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
WHERE T3.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud'

SELECT budget.spent
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'September Meeting'
  AND budget.category = 'Food';

SELECT T2.city, T2.state
FROM member AS T1
JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code
WHERE T1.position = 'President'
SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14';
SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM budget 
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id 
WHERE event.event_name = 'November Meeting' 
  AND budget.remaining < 0;

SELECT SUM(budget.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.source = 'Dues'
ORDER BY T2.date_received ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN budget.category = 'Parking' THEN budget.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(budget.amount) AS parking_percentage
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'November Speaker';
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza';

SELECT T1.city, T1.county, T1.state
FROM zip_code AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.zip
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Amy' AND T2.last_name = 'Firth'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code 
WHERE zip_code.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T2.link_to_budget = T3.budget_id
INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T3.link_to_event = T4.event_id
WHERE T4.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT t_shirt_size
FROM member
GROUP BY t_shirt_size
ORDER BY COUNT(t_shirt_size) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.event_name
FROM event AS T1
JOIN budget AS T2
ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
WHERE T1.status = 'Closed'
  AND T2.remaining < 0
ORDER BY T2.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.category,
       SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e 
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;

SELECT budget_id
FROM budget
WHERE category = 'Food'
  AND amount = (SELECT MAX(amount)
                FROM budget
                WHERE category = 'Food');
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Parking';
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20';

SELECT T1.major_name
FROM major AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Phillip' AND T2.last_name = 'Cullen'

SELECT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';
SELECT type FROM event WHERE event_date = '2020-03-24T12:00:00';

SELECT T1.major_name 
FROM major AS T1 
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major 
WHERE T2.position = 'Vice President'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income WHERE amount = 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM major 
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences' 
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE mj.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
WHERE T1.position = 'Member'
  AND T3.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT DISTINCT 
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    a.link_to_event
FROM member m
JOIN expense e 
    ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance a 
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT m.email
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND e.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'education'
  AND mj.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(T1.cost) / COUNT(T3.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense AS T1
JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id
JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
JOIN member AS T4 ON T1.link_to_member = T4.member_id
WHERE T4.position != 'Member';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT member.last_name, member.phone
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT T3.city
FROM member AS T1
JOIN zip_code AS T3 ON T1.zip = T3.zip_code
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name, superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY superhero.height_cm DESC;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics');

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN alignment.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(superhero.id), 2) AS percentage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN alignment.alignment = 'Bad' AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_comics_count
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) 
FROM superhero AS T1 
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female'

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
WHERE T2.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(CASE WHEN skin_colour_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT T1.height_cm
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS T3
JOIN gender AS T1 ON T3.gender_id = T1.id
JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T3.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       * 100.0 / COUNT(superhero.id) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T2.height_cm)
FROM publisher AS T1
INNER JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.publisher_id
INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T2.race_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.race <> 'Human' AND T1.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM hero_attribute 
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id 
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id 
FROM hero_power AS T1 
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero
);

SELECT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Date, (STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_abnormal_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_abnormal_count,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 
        2
    ) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday))
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.UA = '8.4' 
    AND Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND ANA = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT (AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`)) * 0.2
        FROM Examination
        WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND ANA = 'S'
      );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') / COUNT(SEX) * 100
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT DATEDIFF(MIN(`Examination Date`), `First Date`)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT p.ID, l.ALP < 300 AS is_ALP_normal
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT T1.ID, T2.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.Description, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID,
       CASE 
           WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS ALB_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(T3.Date)
    FROM Laboratory AS T3
    WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
)
AND (
    (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
    OR
    (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5)
);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS Answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
ORDER BY L.`T-CHO` DESC, P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1.ID IN (
    SELECT T2.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS T2
    WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
)
AND SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) < '2000' 
  AND T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(atom_id)
                   FROM atom
                   WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id
                                         FROM molecule
                                         WHERE label = '+'))
FROM bond
WHERE bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id
                      FROM molecule
                      WHERE label = '+');

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.label = '-'
ORDER BY T1.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
  AND T2.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS proportion
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.element)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T1.molecule_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '-';

SELECT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
   OR molecule_id = 'TR001'
   OR molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS has_both
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a 
  ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T1.element, COUNT(*)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'
  AND substr(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY T1.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 's'
)
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT T2.label
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'

SELECT atom.molecule_id 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT molecule_id 
FROM atom 
WHERE element = 's' 
INTERSECT 
SELECT molecule_id 
FROM bond 
WHERE bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT frpm.`School Name`,
       frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY `Eligible Free Rate` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.sname
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T1.Magnet = 1

SELECT T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
ORDER BY T2.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT `CDSCode`
FROM frpm
GROUP BY `CDSCode`, `School Name`
HAVING SUM(`Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500

SELECT T2.District
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'

WITH czk_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_totals t
    JOIN min_totals m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;
