FROM Match
WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Poland')
  AND season = '2010/2011';

SELECT DISTINCT player_name 
FROM Player 
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id 
    FROM Player_Attributes 
    WHERE overall_rating > 80 
      AND strftime('%Y', date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010'
);

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;
SELECT name FROM Country WHERE id = (SELECT country_id FROM League WHERE name = 'Italy Serie A');

FROM Match m 
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id 
WHERE l.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' 
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', m.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

FROM Player AS P

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match

FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'

ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986';
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Abdou Diallo')

JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT defensive_work_rate 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud') 
  AND date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

    SELECT *
    FROM Match
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Belgium')
),
belgium_players AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_2 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_3 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_4 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_5 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_6 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_7 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_8 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_9 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_10 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_11 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_1 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_2 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_3 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_4 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_5 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_6 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_7 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_8 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_9 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_10 FROM belgium_matches
    UNION
    SELECT away_player_11 FROM belgium_matches
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN belgium_players bp ON p.player_api_id = bp.player_api_id;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT co.name AS country, AVG(p.weight) AS average_weight
FROM match_players m
JOIN Player p ON m.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Country co ON m.country_id = co.id
GROUP BY co.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

    SELECT *
    FROM Match
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
),
italy_player_ids AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS player_id FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_2 FROM italy_match

    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_4 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_5 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_6 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_7 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_8 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_9 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_1 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_2 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_3 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_4 FROM italy_match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_5 FROM italy_match

FROM Player p

SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name LIMIT 3;

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'

       AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
       CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

FROM district d

FROM client c

SELECT d.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS salary_gap
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id IN (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
      / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
        WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      )
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

WITH bad_heroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
),
total_heroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM superhero
),
marvel_bad_heroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS marvel_bad_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
      AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT bad_count FROM bad_heroes) / (SELECT total_count FROM total_heroes), 2) AS bad_alignment_percentage,
    (SELECT marvel_bad_count FROM marvel_bad_heroes) AS marvel_comics_bad_count;

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_cnt
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN inpatient_cnt > outpatient_cnt THEN 'in-patient'
        ELSE 'outpatient'
    END AS more_common,
    (inpatient_cnt - outpatient_cnt) * 100.0 / outpatient_cnt AS deviation_percentage
FROM counts;

WITH thrombosis_level_2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis = 2
),
ana_pattern_s AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ANA = 'S'
),
avg_threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2 AS igm_threshold
    FROM Examination
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination e
JOIN thrombosis_level_2 t ON e.ID = t.ID
JOIN ana_pattern_s a ON e.ID = a.ID
CROSS JOIN avg_threshold
WHERE e.`aCL IgM` > avg_threshold.igm_threshold;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(bond_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(bond_id) AS bond_count
        FROM bond
        GROUP BY bond_type
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '-';

WITH carcinogenic AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
),
single_bond_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS bond_cnt
    FROM bond
    JOIN carcinogenic ON bond.molecule_id = carcinogenic.molecule_id
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
),
atom_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_cnt
    FROM atom
    JOIN carcinogenic ON atom.molecule_id = carcinogenic.molecule_id
)
SELECT single_bond_count.bond_cnt * 1.0 / atom_count.atom_cnt AS avg_single_bonded
FROM single_bond_count, atom_count;

WITH double_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
),
double_bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom a
    JOIN double_bond_molecules d ON a.molecule_id = d.molecule_id
)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom_id) AS percentage_carbon
FROM double_bond_atoms;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c

WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT T.element
FROM (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
    GROUP BY element
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') - (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-');

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

FROM molecule

SELECT bond_type

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_carcinogenic

    FROM molecule

);

WITH double_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
top_molecule AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM double_bond_counts
    ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN top_molecule tm ON m.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
);

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR041')
  AND b.bond_type = '#'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR041')
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2

    FROM atom

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- All 2013 consumption records of customers paying in CZK
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
lowest AS (
    -- Minimum consumption per segment in 2013 (CZK customers)
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_low AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cz.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 cz
    JOIN lowest l
      ON cz.Segment = l.Segment
     AND cz.Consumption = l.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)

JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent

SELECT bond_id

         WHEN (SELECT m.label
               FROM molecule m
               JOIN (SELECT molecule_id
                     FROM bond
                     WHERE bond_type = ' = '
                     GROUP BY molecule_id
                     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
                     LIMIT 1) b
                 ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id) = '+'
         THEN 'YES'
         ELSE 'NO'
       END AS is_carcinogenic;

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

SELECT m.molecule_id

SELECT T1.atom_id2

JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
HAVING COUNT(T1.bond_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM connected AS C1
        JOIN atom AS A1 ON C1.atom_id = A1.atom_id
        JOIN atom AS A2 ON C1.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
        GROUP BY A1.element, A2.element

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)

SELECT CASE WHEN (

SELECT m.label

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

WITH customer_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (CZK payers only)
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c 
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segment_minimums AS (
    -- Lowest consumption value within each segment
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption
    -- customer(s) / number of such customer(s)
    SELECT 
        ct.Segment,
        SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_totals AS ct
    JOIN segment_minimums AS sm 
        ON sm.Segment = ct.Segment
       AND sm.min_consumption = ct.total_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT DISTINCT

    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Match m
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,

    )
JOIN Country c

FROM Player P
JOIN (
    SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_2  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_3  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_4  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_5  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_6  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_7  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_8  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_9  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_10 FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.home_player_11 FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.away_player_1  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.away_player_2  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.away_player_3  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.away_player_4  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.away_player_5  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.away_player_6  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.away_player_7  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.away_player_8  FROM Match M
    UNION ALL SELECT M.country_id, M.away_player_9  FROM Match M

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatient_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'More male in-patients'
        ELSE 'More male outpatients'
    END AS comparison,
    -- Deviation % = (in-patients - outpatients) / outpatients * 100
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_inpatient
FROM Patient

SELECT DISTINCT element

SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)

JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms

JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

SELECT m.molecule_id

JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenic_label,

    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    AND b.bond_type = ' = '

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type)

SELECT
  -- SME's annual average minus LAM's annual average
  (
    SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T1.Consumption = (
          SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
          FROM yearmonth AS T3
          JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
          WHERE T4.Segment = 'SME'
            AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
      )
  )
  -
  (
    SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T1.Consumption = (
          SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
          FROM yearmonth AS T3
          JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
          WHERE T4.Segment = 'LAM'
            AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
      )
  ) AS diff_SME_LAM,

  -- LAM's annual average minus KAM's annual average
  (
    SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T1.Consumption = (
          SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
          FROM yearmonth AS T3
          JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
          WHERE T4.Segment = 'LAM'
            AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
      )
  )
  -
  (
    SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T1.Consumption = (
          SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
          FROM yearmonth AS T3
          JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
          WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM'
            AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
      )
  ) AS diff_LAM_KAM,

  -- KAM's annual average minus SME's annual average
  (
    SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T1.Consumption = (
          SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
          FROM yearmonth AS T3
          JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
          WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM'
            AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
      )
  )
  -
  (
    SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T1.Consumption = (
          SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
          FROM yearmonth AS T3
          JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
          WHERE T4.Segment = 'SME'
            AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'

  ) AS diff_KAM_SME;

        WHEN 'B' THEN 'finished - debt left unpaid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'running - payments up to date'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers

  FROM yearmonth ym

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals t
    JOIN min_totals m
      ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND m.min_consumption = t.total_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM avg_per_segment;

WITH male_counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count

)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN inpatient_count > outpatient_count THEN 'More male in-patients'
        WHEN inpatient_count < outpatient_count THEN 'More male outpatients'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS comparison,
    CAST(inpatient_count AS REAL) / outpatient_count AS deviation_percentage
FROM male_counts;

    SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
),

    SELECT b.bond_id,
           CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_single_bond
    FROM bond b
    JOIN carcinogenic_molecules cm ON b.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
),
single_bond_count AS (

JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;

-
(SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth)) AS d1,
(SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth))
-
(SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth)) AS d2,
(SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth))
-
(SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth)) AS d3

SELECT T1.CustomerID
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'Euro' AND T2.Date = '201310'
ORDER BY T2.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date = 201305

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN y.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'Euro' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'KAM'
SELECT MAX(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

SELECT MAX(monthly_consumption) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'Euro'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)
SELECT DISTINCT T2.Description FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T3.Date = '201309'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Country FROM gasstations AS T1 JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Date LIKE '2013-06%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000;

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Segment FROM customers WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k ORDER BY Date ASC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00'

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date = '201306' AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 548.4

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';
SELECT SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 38508 AND Date = '201201'

SELECT t.CustomerID, SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item, c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes) LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_name, height FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player);
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating > (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010')
  AND overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010');
SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(PA.long_shots) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_fifa_api_id = PA.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) * 1.0 / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name, TA.chanceCreationPassing
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers'

SELECT DISTINCT Player_Attributes.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';
SELECT PA.heading_accuracy FROM Player_Attributes AS PA JOIN Player AS P ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.player_name = 'Francois Affolter' AND PA.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT PA.preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
ORDER BY P.birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands';
SELECT AVG(M.home_team_goal) FROM Match M JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id WHERE C.name = 'Poland' AND M.season = '2010/2011';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1990';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', PA.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id = Team.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE Team.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga') AND strftime('%Y-%m', date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(Match.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04'

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(T1.overall_rating) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < '1986'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.preferred_foot FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'
SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'

FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77 AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

FROM Player_Attributes PA

WHERE P.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
